ex.en: I think it necessary for you to study harder.
ex.zh: 我覺得你需要更用功。

ex.en: Taninna goes to the library and studies every day.
ex.zh: 塔寧娜每天都去圖書館念書。

ex.en: I talked with my parents about my studying abroad.
ex.zh: 我跟爸媽談了出國留學的事。

study.en: to spend time learning about a subject, usually from books

ex.en: A new study shows that coffee may be good for the heart.
ex.zh: 一項新研究顯示咖啡可能對心臟有益。

ex.en: The study involved 2,000 people.
ex.zh: 這項研究有兩千人參與。

study.en: a piece of work in which people carefully examine a subject to learn about it

ex.en: My phone needs to have enough storage for my apps.
ex.zh: 我的手機需要有足夠的空間放 App。

ex.en: Cloud storage lets you access files anywhere.
ex.zh: 雲端儲存讓你隨時隨地存取檔案。

storage.en: the amount of space for keeping information or things

ex.en: We keep old furniture in storage.
ex.zh: 我們把舊家具放在倉庫裡。

ex.en: The apartment has plenty of storage space.
ex.zh: 這間公寓有很多收納空間。

storage.en: the act of keeping things in a place until they are needed

ex.en: The manager wants to improve the company's structuring.
ex.zh: 經理想改善公司的組織結構。

ex.en: Mangroves absorb more carbon dioxide than any other trees on Earth because they have large underground root structures.
ex.zh: 紅樹林的地下根系結構很大，所以吸收的二氧化碳比地球上其他樹都多。

structure.en: the way the parts of something are arranged and connected

ex.en: This is the most massive structure I have ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我見過最龐大的建築。

ex.en: The school's tallest structure is that water tower.
ex.zh: 學校最高的建築物就是那座水塔。

structure.en: something that has been built, such as a building or bridge

ex.en: Steel is a key industry.
ex.zh: 鋼鐵是重點產業。

ex.en: According to an estimate, steel production will reach 100 million tons this year.
ex.zh: 據估計，今年鋼鐵產量將達到一億噸。

ex.en: There are daisies next to the steel building.
ex.zh: 鋼骨大樓旁邊開著雛菊。

steel.en: a strong hard metal made from iron

ex.en: There were a lot of excited fans in the stadium.
ex.zh: 體育場裡有很多興奮的球迷。

ex.en: A stage has been set up in the stadium.
ex.zh: 體育場內已經搭好了舞台。

ex.en: The stadium was flooded with baseball fans.
ex.zh: 體育場擠滿了棒球迷。

stadium.en: a large open building where sports events are held

ex.en: Tom put a stack of letters on Mary's desk.
ex.zh: 湯姆把一疊信放在瑪麗桌上。

ex.en: I have a stack of emails to answer.
ex.zh: 我有一大堆電子郵件要回。

stack.en: a pile of things on top of each other

ex.en: Please stack the chairs after the meeting.
ex.zh: 會議結束後請把椅子疊起來。

ex.en: The boxes were stacked against the wall.
ex.zh: 箱子靠著牆堆放。

stack.en: to put things on top of each other in a pile

ex.en: The rule of the road must be strictly observed.
ex.zh: 交通規則必須嚴格遵守。

ex.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited in the building.
ex.zh: 大樓內嚴禁吸菸。

strictly.en: in a way that must be obeyed exactly

ex.en: Strictly speaking, this sentence is grammatically incorrect.
ex.zh: 嚴格來說，這句話文法上是錯的。

ex.en: Strictly speaking, the theory is not correct.
ex.zh: 嚴格來說，這套理論並不正確。

strictly.en: used to say what is exactly true according to the rules

ex.en: The aviation expert analyzed the statistics in detail.
ex.zh: 航空專家詳細分析了統計數據。

ex.en: According to official statistics, unemployment fell last year.
ex.zh: 根據官方統計，去年失業率下降了。

statistics.en: numbers and facts collected to show information about something

ex.en: I'm taking a statistics class this semester.
ex.zh: 我這學期修了一門統計學。

ex.en: She has a degree in statistics.
ex.zh: 她擁有統計學學位。

statistics.en: the study of collecting and understanding numbers and data

ex.en: This statue is as large as life.
ex.zh: 這座雕像和真人一樣大。

ex.en: The statue was carved from a block of cherry wood.
ex.zh: 這座雕像是用一塊櫻桃木雕成的。

ex.en: In the center of the university campus stands the statue of the founder.
ex.zh: 大學校園中央矗立著創辦人的雕像。

statue.en: a figure of a person or animal made from stone or metal

ex.en: The patient is steadily recovering.
ex.zh: 這位病人正穩定康復中。

ex.en: Prices have been rising steadily.
ex.zh: 物價一直在穩定上升。

ex.en: Our sales have grown steadily since 2020.
ex.zh: 我們的銷售額從 2020 年起穩定成長。

steadily.en: in a regular and continuous way

ex.en: The stockholders will meet next month.
ex.zh: 股東們下個月要開會。

ex.en: Stockholders received a higher dividend this year.
ex.zh: 股東今年領到較高的股利。

stockholder.en: a person who owns shares in a company

ex.en: Will you please lend me a stapler?
ex.zh: 可以借我一下釘書機嗎？

ex.en: The stapler is out of staples.
ex.zh: 釘書機沒有釘書針了。

stapler.en: a tool that joins papers together with small pieces of metal

ex.en: How would you like your steak?
ex.zh: 您的牛排要幾分熟？

ex.en: She said she felt like eating steak.
ex.zh: 她說她想吃牛排。

ex.en: I thought you'd be full after eating that big steak.
ex.zh: 我以為你吃完那塊大牛排就飽了。

steak.en: a thick flat piece of meat or fish, cooked and eaten

ex.en: Chia-ling said her grandma knows how to use LINE now. She sends stickers every day.
ex.zh: 佳玲說她阿嬤現在會用 LINE 了，每天都傳貼圖。

ex.en: My daughter put stickers all over her notebook.
ex.zh: 我女兒在筆記本上貼滿了貼紙。

ex.en: Check the price on the sticker.
ex.zh: 看一下貼紙上的價格。

sticker.en: a small picture or label that you attach to something, or send in a chat app

ex.en: Rice is a staple in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 米飯在台灣是主食。

ex.en: Bread and milk are kitchen staples.
ex.zh: 麵包和牛奶是廚房必備品。

staple.en: a basic food or product that people use all the time

ex.en: The stapler is out of staples.
ex.zh: 釘書機沒有訂書針了。

ex.en: Remove the staples before you shred the documents.
ex.zh: 碎紙前先把訂書針拔掉。

staple.en: a small piece of thin metal used to hold papers together

ex.en: Please staple these pages together.
ex.zh: 請把這幾頁釘在一起。

ex.en: She stapled the receipt to the form.
ex.zh: 她把收據釘在表格上。

staple.en: to join papers together with small pieces of metal

ex.en: This project offers strategic advantages for Algeria.
ex.zh: 這項專案為阿爾及利亞帶來戰略優勢。

ex.en: We need a strategic plan for next year.
ex.zh: 我們需要擬定明年的策略計畫。

ex.en: The company made a strategic decision to expand into Asia.
ex.zh: 公司做出進軍亞洲的策略性決定。

strategic.en: done as part of a careful plan to achieve a goal

ex.en: Zebra shadows don't have stripes.
ex.zh: 斑馬的影子沒有條紋。

ex.en: The stripes were horizontal.
ex.zh: 這些條紋是橫的。

ex.en: The flag has red and white stripes.
ex.zh: 這面旗子有紅白條紋。

stripe.en: a long narrow line of color

ex.en: Japanese cars' steering wheels are on the right.
ex.zh: 日本車的方向盤在右邊。

ex.en: He steered the car into the parking space.
ex.zh: 他把車開進停車格。

steer.en: to control the direction of a vehicle

ex.en: She tried to steer the conversation away from politics.
ex.zh: 她試著把話題從政治上岔開。

ex.en: The new CEO steered the company through the crisis.
ex.zh: 新任執行長帶領公司度過了危機。

steer.en: to guide a person or a conversation in a particular direction

ex.en: You should steer clear of that area at night.
ex.zh: 晚上你最好避開那一帶。

ex.en: Try to steer clear of fast food.
ex.zh: 盡量避免吃速食。

steer.en: to stay away from someone or something

ex.en: Put a record on the stereo.
ex.zh: 在音響上放一張唱片吧。

ex.en: Can you turn down the stereo?
ex.zh: 你可以把音響轉小聲一點嗎？

ex.en: My neighbor plays his stereo too loudly.
ex.zh: 我鄰居的音響開得太大聲了。

stereo.en: a machine for playing music with sound from two speakers

ex.en: These stereo headphones have great sound.
ex.zh: 這副立體聲耳機音質很棒。

ex.en: Stereo speakers give you better sound.
ex.zh: 立體聲喇叭的音效比較好。

stereo.en: playing sound through two speakers so it seems to come from different places

ex.en: I forgot to lock the storeroom.
ex.zh: 我忘了鎖儲藏室。

ex.en: Extra chairs are kept in the storeroom.
ex.zh: 多的椅子放在儲藏室裡。

storeroom.en: a room where things are kept until they are needed

stimulus.zh: 刺激、激勵（因素）；（經濟）振興措施

ex.en: The government announced a stimulus package to boost the economy.
ex.zh: 政府宣布了一項振興經濟的方案。

ex.en: Low interest rates act as a stimulus to spending.
ex.zh: 低利率能刺激消費。

stimulus.en: something that makes a person, thing or economy become more active

ex.en: My uncle worked as a stockbroker for twenty years.
ex.zh: 我叔叔當了二十年的股票經紀人。

ex.en: Ask your stockbroker before you buy those shares.
ex.zh: 買那些股票之前，先問問你的股票經紀人。

stockbroker.en: a person whose job is to buy and sell shares for other people

ex.en: The stock market fell sharply this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上股市大跌。

ex.en: She lost a lot of money in the stock market.
ex.zh: 她在股市虧了很多錢。

stock market.en: the place or system where shares in companies are bought and sold

ex.en: The report includes a detailed statistical analysis.
ex.zh: 這份報告包含詳細的統計分析。

ex.en: There is no statistical difference between the two groups.
ex.zh: 這兩組之間在統計上沒有差異。

statistical.en: relating to numbers and facts collected about something

ex.en: Employees are entitled to statutory holidays.
ex.zh: 員工享有法定假日。

ex.en: The company failed to meet its statutory obligations.
ex.zh: 這家公司沒有履行法定義務。

ex.en: We need to standardize our reporting process.
ex.zh: 我們需要把報告流程標準化。

ex.en: All forms have been standardized across departments.
ex.zh: 所有表單已在各部門統一格式。

standardize.en: to make things the same, following one set of rules

ex.en: The process is quite straightforward.
ex.zh: 流程相當簡單。

ex.en: The instructions are clear and straightforward.
ex.zh: 說明清楚易懂。

straightforward.en: easy to do or understand, with no difficulties

ex.en: He's very straightforward.
ex.zh: 他講話很直接。

ex.en: She gave me a straightforward answer.
ex.zh: 她給了我一個坦白的回答。

straightforward.en: honest and clear in what you say

ex.en: The price is quoted in sterling.
ex.zh: 價格以英鎊報價。

ex.en: Sterling fell against the euro.
ex.zh: 英鎊對歐元下跌。

sterling.en: the money used in the United Kingdom

ex.en: She did a sterling job on the project.
ex.zh: 她在這個專案上表現出色。

ex.en: He has a sterling reputation.
ex.zh: 他的名聲極好。

ex.en: Prices have started to stabilize.
ex.zh: 物價開始趨於穩定。

ex.en: The government took steps to stabilize the economy.
ex.zh: 政府採取措施穩定經濟。

ex.en: The patient's condition has stabilized.
ex.zh: 病人的狀況已經穩定下來了。

stabilize.en: to stop changing or moving, or to make something do so

ex.en: No matter how hard I strive, I fail to achieve my parents' requirements.
ex.zh: 不管我多努力，都達不到父母的要求。

ex.en: We strive to provide the best service.
ex.zh: 我們努力提供最好的服務。

ex.en: The company strives for excellence in everything it does.
ex.zh: 公司凡事力求卓越。

strive.en: to try very hard to do or get something

ex.en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
ex.zh: 這條小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。

ex.en: The road up the hill is very steep.
ex.zh: 上山的路非常陡。

steep.en: rising or falling at a sharp angle

ex.en: The prices at this hotel are a bit steep.
ex.zh: 這家飯店的價格有點太貴了。

ex.en: There was a steep rise in sales last quarter.
ex.zh: 上一季銷售額急劇上升。

steep.en: very high in price, or going up or down very quickly

ex.en: My cousin is so steeped in schoolwork that his friends call him bookworm.
ex.zh: 我表弟太埋首於課業，朋友都叫他書呆子。

ex.en: Steep the tea for three minutes.
ex.zh: 把茶葉浸泡三分鐘。

steep.en: to leave something in liquid, or to be deeply involved in something

ex.en: For years he has been at the market every Tuesday morning with his fish stall.
ex.zh: 多年來，他每週二早上都會在市場擺魚攤。

ex.en: We bought fruit from a stall at the night market.
ex.zh: 我們在夜市的一個攤位買了水果。

stall.en: a small table or place where things are sold in a market

ex.en: Talks with the union have stalled.
ex.zh: 與工會的協商陷入停滯。

ex.en: Stop stalling and give me an answer.
ex.zh: 別再拖了，給我一個答案。

stall.en: to stop making progress, or to delay on purpose

ex.en: My car stalled at the traffic light.
ex.zh: 我的車在紅綠燈前熄火了。

ex.en: The engine stalled twice this morning.
ex.zh: 引擎今天早上熄火了兩次。

stall.en: to stop working suddenly, when talking about an engine

ex.en: Sales have remained static for months.
ex.zh: 銷售額已經好幾個月停滯不前。

ex.en: This website only has static pages.
ex.zh: 這個網站只有靜態網頁。

ex.en: There was a lot of static on the phone line.
ex.zh: 電話線上雜音很多。

ex.en: My hair is full of static in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天我的頭髮很容易起靜電。

static.en: a crackling noise on a radio or phone, or electricity that builds up on things

ex.en: The model uses a stochastic process.
ex.zh: 這個模型使用隨機過程。

ex.en: Stock prices are often described as stochastic.
ex.zh: 股價常被形容為隨機變動的。

stochastic.en: happening by chance, with results that can only be guessed in terms of chance

ex.en: Water turns into steam when it is boiled.
ex.zh: 水煮沸後會變成蒸汽。

ex.en: Do you know if there's a steam room anywhere around here?
ex.zh: 你知道這附近哪裡有蒸氣室嗎？

steam.en: the hot gas that water becomes when it boils

ex.en: Steam the vegetables for five minutes.
ex.zh: 把蔬菜蒸五分鐘。

ex.en: I steamed some fish for dinner.
ex.zh: 我晚餐蒸了一條魚。

steam.en: to cook food using the hot gas from boiling water

ex.en: I'd like a steaming hot cup of tea.
ex.zh: 我想要一杯熱騰騰的茶。

ex.en: Water steams when it boils.
ex.zh: 水沸騰時會冒出蒸汽。

steam.en: to give off hot gas because of being very hot

steam.zh: run out of steam：沒力、後繼無力

ex.en: The project ran out of steam after the manager left.
ex.zh: 經理離開後，這個專案就後繼無力了。

ex.en: I usually run out of steam by Friday afternoon.
ex.zh: 我通常到星期五下午就沒力了。

steam.en: to lose energy or strength to continue

ex.en: Statistically, women live longer than men.
ex.zh: 從統計來看，女性比男性長壽。

ex.en: The difference is not statistically significant.
ex.zh: 這個差異在統計上並不顯著。

statistically.en: in a way that relates to numbers and facts collected about something

ex.en: Bill is still a legendary figure in this company.
ex.zh: 比爾在這家公司仍是個傳奇人物。

ex.en: As far as I know, she is still missing.
ex.zh: 據我所知，她仍然下落不明。

ex.en: I have to do laundry while it's still sunny.
ex.zh: 我得趁還出太陽的時候洗衣服。

ex.en: The hotel was expensive. Still, it was worth it.
ex.zh: 飯店很貴，但還是很值得。

ex.en: It was raining. Still, we went hiking.
ex.zh: 當時在下雨，但我們還是去爬山了。

still.en: used to show that something is true in spite of what was just said

ex.en: Please stand still for the photo.
ex.zh: 拍照時請站著別動。

ex.en: The lake was calm and still.
ex.zh: 湖面平靜無波。

ex.en: In Japan a new school year starts in April.
ex.zh: 日本的新學年從四月開始。

ex.en: The dance had already started when I got there.
ex.zh: 我到的時候，舞會已經開始了。

ex.en: Starting tomorrow, it's going to snow for a week.
ex.zh: 從明天開始，會連續下一週的雪。

start.en: to begin doing something, or to begin to happen

ex.en: Start at once, or you will miss the bus.
ex.zh: 馬上出發，不然你會錯過公車。

ex.en: We started early to avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 我們提早出發以避開車潮。

ex.en: She started her own company.
ex.zh: 她創辦了自己的公司。

ex.en: The car won't start.
ex.zh: 車子發不動。

start.en: to make a business begin, or to make a machine begin working

ex.en: The start of the project was delayed.
ex.zh: 專案的開始時間延後了。

ex.en: It was a good start.
ex.zh: 這是個好的開始。

start.en: the first part or moment of something

ex.en: Texas is a large state.
ex.zh: 德州是個大州。

ex.en: She lives in the state of California.
ex.zh: 她住在加州。

state.en: one of the large parts that some countries are divided into

ex.en: The house was in a bad state.
ex.zh: 那棟房子狀況很差。

ex.en: He was in a state of shock.
ex.zh: 他處於震驚狀態。

state.en: the condition that someone or something is in

ex.en: The government clearly stated its intention to lower taxes.
ex.zh: 政府明確表示有意降稅。

ex.en: Please state your name and address.
ex.zh: 請說明您的姓名和地址。

state.en: to say or write something clearly and formally

ex.en: I was a high school student at that time.
ex.zh: 我那時是高中生。

ex.en: As far as I know, he's a diligent student.
ex.zh: 據我所知，他是個很用功的學生。

ex.en: It is the students' duty to clean their classrooms.
ex.zh: 打掃教室是學生的責任。

student.en: a person who is learning at a school or university

ex.en: When I saw the picture, I remembered the story.
ex.zh: 看到那幅畫，我就想起了那個故事。

ex.en: He suddenly took a liking to detective stories.
ex.zh: 他突然喜歡上偵探小說。

ex.en: He would often read detective stories after supper.
ex.zh: 他常在晚餐後看偵探小說。

story.en: a description of real or imaginary events that is told or written

ex.en: The story is not in accord with the facts.
ex.zh: 這個說法與事實不符。

ex.en: I'll be in trouble if the story gets out.
ex.zh: 要是這件事傳出去，我就麻煩了。

story.en: an account of what happened, or a news report

ex.en: They live in a two-story house.
ex.zh: 他們住在一棟兩層樓的房子。

ex.en: The hotel is a ten-story building.
ex.zh: 那家飯店是一棟十層樓的建築。

ex.en: Do you know the girl standing by the window?
ex.zh: 你認識站在窗邊的那個女孩嗎？

ex.en: Tom is standing in the corner of the room.
ex.zh: 湯姆站在房間的角落。

stand.en: to be on your feet in an upright position

ex.en: I can't stand the noise in this office.
ex.zh: 我受不了這間辦公室的噪音。

ex.en: How can you stand working with him?
ex.zh: 你怎麼受得了跟他一起工作？

stand.en: to be able to bear something unpleasant

ex.en: I don't know what this symbol stands for.
ex.zh: 我不知道這個符號代表什麼。

ex.en: What does TOEIC stand for?
ex.zh: TOEIC 是什麼的縮寫？

stand.en: to be a sign of something, or to have a particular meaning

ex.en: The house stood out because of its unusual shape.
ex.zh: 那棟房子因為造型特別而很顯眼。

ex.en: Your resume needs to stand out.
ex.zh: 你的履歷需要脫穎而出。

stand.en: to be easy to see or notice

ex.en: We set up a stand at the trade show.
ex.zh: 我們在商展設了一個攤位。

ex.en: There's a fruit stand near the station.
ex.zh: 車站附近有一個水果攤。

stand.en: a small table or structure where things are sold or shown

ex.en: It has finally stopped snowing and has warmed up.
ex.zh: 雪終於停了，天氣也變暖了。

ex.en: When it stops raining, let's go for a walk.
ex.zh: 雨停了我們就去散步吧。

ex.en: I stopped smoking for the sake of my health.
ex.zh: 為了健康，我戒菸了。

stop.en: to end an action or movement

ex.en: He just looked on and didn't stop the quarrel.
ex.zh: 他只是在旁邊看，沒有阻止那場爭吵。

ex.en: Nothing can stop us now.
ex.zh: 現在沒有什麼能阻止我們了。

stop.en: to prevent someone from doing something or something from happening

ex.en: I get off at the next stop.
ex.zh: 我下一站下車。

ex.en: Where is the nearest bus stop?
ex.zh: 最近的公車站在哪裡？

stop.en: a place where buses or trains regularly let people on and off

ex.en: Let's stop for coffee on the way.
ex.zh: 我們路上停下來喝杯咖啡吧。

ex.en: Does this train stop at Taichung?
ex.zh: 這班火車有停台中嗎？

stop.en: to pause a journey for a short time, or to come to a place and wait

ex.en: I think you're a lot stronger than you know.
ex.zh: 我覺得你比自己以為的堅強得多。

ex.en: Tom is strong enough to lift the box.
ex.zh: 湯姆力氣夠大，搬得動這個箱子。

strong.en: having a lot of physical power, or able to deal with hard times well

ex.en: The strong wind indicates that a storm is coming.
ex.zh: 強風顯示暴風雨即將來臨。

ex.en: The ship made slow progress against the strong wind.
ex.zh: 這艘船頂著強風緩慢前進。

strong.zh: 有實力的、擅長的；穩固的

ex.en: He was the strongest candidate for the position.
ex.zh: 他是這個職位最有力的人選。

ex.en: Mathematics is his strongest subject.
ex.zh: 數學是他最擅長的科目。

ex.en: The company has a strong position in the market.
ex.zh: 這家公司在市場上地位穩固。

strong.en: good at something, or well built and not likely to fail

ex.en: I don't know what the next step should be.
ex.zh: 我不知道下一步該怎麼做。

ex.en: The first step is to fill out this form.
ex.zh: 第一步是填寫這張表格。

ex.en: The company is taking steps to reduce costs.
ex.zh: 公司正採取措施降低成本。

step.en: one action in a series taken to achieve something

ex.en: You may want to take a few steps back.
ex.zh: 你可能要往後退幾步。

ex.en: He took a step forward and smiled.
ex.zh: 他向前走了一步，露出微笑。

step.en: the movement of lifting one foot and putting it down

ex.en: He went up the steps slowly.
ex.zh: 他慢慢走上台階。

ex.en: She was sitting on the front steps.
ex.zh: 她坐在門口的台階上。

step.en: a flat surface you put your foot on to go up or down

ex.en: English is something to be learned step by step.
ex.zh: 英文要一步一步地學。

ex.en: The guide explains the process step by step.
ex.zh: 這份指南一步一步說明流程。

step.en: slowly, one stage at a time

ex.en: I almost stepped on a skunk last night.
ex.zh: 我昨晚差點踩到一隻臭鼬。

ex.en: Please step aside and let them pass.
ex.zh: 請讓開讓他們過去。

step.en: to put your foot down on something, or to move by walking

ex.en: A stage has been set up in the stadium.
ex.zh: 體育場裡已經搭好舞台。

ex.en: Are there any famous musicians on the stage?
ex.zh: 舞台上有知名音樂家嗎？

ex.en: What did John sing on the stage?
ex.zh: 約翰在台上唱了什麼？

stage.en: the raised area in a theater where actors perform

ex.en: The project is still in its early stages.
ex.zh: 這個專案還在初期階段。

ex.en: At this stage, we can't give you a date.
ex.zh: 在這個階段，我們還無法給你確切日期。

stage.en: a period or point in a process

ex.en: The company staged a big product launch.
ex.zh: 公司舉辦了盛大的產品發表會。

ex.en: The school will stage a musical next month.
ex.zh: 學校下個月將上演一齣音樂劇。

stage.en: to organize an event, or to perform a play for an audience

ex.en: There are many stores on either side of the street.
ex.zh: 街道兩旁有很多商店。

ex.en: Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
ex.zh: 我走在街上時遇到一位老朋友。

ex.en: You cannot be too careful in crossing a street.
ex.zh: 過馬路再怎麼小心都不為過。

street.en: a road in a town with buildings along it

ex.en: There are many stores on either side of the street.
ex.zh: 街道兩旁有很多商店。

ex.en: I don't really like the stores there.
ex.zh: 我不太喜歡那裡的商店。

ex.en: I like shopping in used-book stores and in used-clothing shops.
ex.zh: 我喜歡逛二手書店和二手衣店。

store.en: a place where goods are sold

ex.en: Store the medicine in a cool, dry place.
ex.zh: 請把藥品存放在陰涼乾燥處。

ex.en: All the data is stored in the cloud.
ex.zh: 所有資料都存在雲端。

store.en: to keep something in a place until it is needed

ex.en: You must be at the station by 5 o'clock.
ex.zh: 你必須在五點前到車站。

ex.en: Please tell me the closest station to your office.
ex.zh: 請告訴我離您辦公室最近的車站。

ex.en: The train from Geneva will arrive at the station.
ex.zh: 從日內瓦來的火車即將進站。

station.en: a place where trains or buses stop for passengers

ex.en: The toilets at motorway service stations are often very dirty.
ex.zh: 高速公路休息站的廁所常常很髒。

ex.en: The police station is next to the bank.
ex.zh: 警察局在銀行旁邊。

station.en: a place or building used for a particular service or job

ex.en: Our stuff got stolen, and we missed our train.
ex.zh: 我們的東西被偷了，還錯過了火車。

ex.en: Can't you move your stuff to the other room?
ex.zh: 你不能把你的東西搬到另一個房間嗎？

ex.en: I'm going to get rid of all this stuff.
ex.zh: 我要把這些東西全部處理掉。

stuff.en: things, objects or material of any kind

ex.en: The secretary stuffed the letter into an envelope.
ex.zh: 秘書把信塞進信封。

ex.en: You can't get the suitcase closed because you've stuffed too much into it.
ex.zh: 你塞了太多東西，所以行李箱關不起來。

stuff.en: to push something into a small space

ex.en: "Will they go on strike again?" "I'm afraid so."
ex.zh: 「他們又要罷工了嗎？」「恐怕是的。」

ex.en: The workers went on strike for higher pay.
ex.zh: 工人們為了爭取加薪而罷工。

strike.en: a time when workers refuse to work, usually to ask for better pay

ex.en: Tom has been struck by lightning three times.
ex.zh: 湯姆被閃電擊中過三次。

ex.en: The ball struck him on the head.
ex.zh: 球打中了他的頭。

strike.en: to hit someone or something hard, or to attack suddenly

ex.en: It struck me that she looked tired.
ex.zh: 我突然覺得她看起來很累。

ex.en: What struck me most was the view.
ex.zh: 最讓我印象深刻的是景色。

strike.en: to come into your mind suddenly, or to seem a certain way to someone

ex.en: We finally struck a deal with the supplier.
ex.zh: 我們終於和供應商達成協議。

ex.en: The two companies struck a deal last week.
ex.zh: 兩家公司上週達成了協議。

strike.en: to reach an agreement with someone

ex.en: In consequence of a new agreement between two competitors, we need to readjust our strategies.
ex.zh: 由於兩個競爭對手達成新協議，我們需要重新調整策略。

ex.en: Hope is not a strategy.
ex.zh: 希望不是一種策略。

ex.en: We need a new marketing strategy.
ex.zh: 我們需要新的行銷策略。

strategy.en: a careful plan for achieving something

ex.en: The earth is not a star, but a planet.
ex.zh: 地球不是恆星，而是行星。

ex.en: The distance between stars is measured in light years.
ex.zh: 恆星之間的距離是以光年計算的。

ex.en: There was a big gold star on the door.
ex.zh: 門上有一顆大大的金色星星。

star.en: a bright point of light in the night sky

ex.en: She became a movie star at 20.
ex.zh: 她二十歲就成了電影明星。

ex.en: He is the star of the team.
ex.zh: 他是隊上的明星球員。

star.en: a famous performer, or the best person in a group

ex.en: The movie stars Tom Hanks.
ex.zh: 這部電影由湯姆漢克斯主演。

ex.en: She starred in a popular TV series.
ex.zh: 她主演了一部熱門電視劇。

star.en: to have a main part in a film or play

ex.en: The living room furniture was modern in style.
ex.zh: 客廳的家具是現代風格。

ex.en: I really like his writing style.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡他的寫作風格。

ex.en: My manager has a relaxed management style.
ex.zh: 我主管的管理風格很輕鬆。

style.en: a particular way of doing or making something

ex.en: This style of hat is now in fashion.
ex.zh: 這種款式的帽子現在很流行。

ex.en: What kind of hair style would you like?
ex.zh: 你想剪什麼樣的髮型？

ex.en: Fashions of thirty years ago have come back in style.
ex.zh: 三十年前的流行款式又重新流行起來了。

style.en: a particular design of something, especially clothes

ex.en: She styled her hair for the party.
ex.zh: 她為了派對做了頭髮造型。

ex.en: The jacket is styled for both work and travel.
ex.zh: 這件外套的設計適合上班也適合旅行。

style.en: to design or arrange something, especially hair or clothes, in a certain way

ex.en: I forgot to stick a stamp on the envelope.
ex.zh: 我忘了在信封上貼郵票。

ex.en: Please stick the label on the box.
ex.zh: 請把標籤貼在箱子上。

stick.en: to fix one thing onto another with glue, or to become fixed to something

ex.en: I'm stuck here in Boston because of the storm.
ex.zh: 我因為暴風雨被困在波士頓。

ex.en: I got a fish bone stuck in my throat.
ex.zh: 我喉嚨被魚刺卡住了。

stick.en: to be unable to move or leave

ex.en: My friend has had three jobs in a year; he never sticks to anything for long.
ex.zh: 我朋友一年換了三份工作，他做什麼都無法持久。

ex.en: Let's stick to the plan.
ex.zh: 我們就照計畫進行吧。

stick.en: to continue doing or following something without changing

ex.en: The old man walks with a stick.
ex.zh: 那位老先生拄著拐杖走路。

ex.en: We collected sticks to make a fire.
ex.zh: 我們撿了一些樹枝來生火。

stick.en: a thin piece of wood, or a long thin object used for walking

ex.en: Tom struggled to keep up with Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆很吃力地跟上瑪麗。

ex.en: I struggled to get out of the subway.
ex.zh: 我費了好大力氣才擠出地鐵。

ex.en: Many small businesses are struggling to survive.
ex.zh: 許多小型企業正在苦撐。

struggle.en: to try very hard to do something difficult

ex.en: It was an uphill struggle.
ex.zh: 那是一場艱苦的奮鬥。

ex.en: Learning a new language can be a struggle.
ex.zh: 學新語言可能很辛苦。

struggle.en: a hard effort to do something, or something very difficult

ex.en: A strange sound was heard from behind the door.
ex.zh: 門後傳來奇怪的聲音。

ex.en: The orange left a strange taste in my mouth.
ex.zh: 柳橙在我嘴裡留下一股怪味。

ex.en: Strange to say, no one voted for the candidate.
ex.zh: 說也奇怪，沒有人投票給那位候選人。

strange.en: unusual or unexpected in a way that is hard to understand

ex.en: I woke up in a strange room.
ex.zh: 我在一個陌生的房間裡醒來。

ex.en: Everything felt strange in the new city at first.
ex.zh: 剛到新城市時，一切都覺得很陌生。

strange.en: not known or not seen before

ex.en: Don't throw stones into the river.
ex.zh: 不要往河裡丟石頭。

ex.en: She picked up beautiful stones.
ex.zh: 她撿了一些漂亮的石頭。

ex.en: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.
ex.zh: 「滾石不生苔」是一句諺語。

stone.en: a small piece of rock, or the hard material that rocks are made of

ex.en: The band is recording a new album in the studio.
ex.zh: 樂團正在錄音室錄新專輯。

ex.en: She opened a small yoga studio downtown.
ex.zh: 她在市中心開了一間小型瑜伽教室。

ex.en: The TV show is filmed in a studio in Taipei.
ex.zh: 這個電視節目在台北的攝影棚錄製。

studio.en: a room where an artist works, or where films, music or programs are made

ex.en: I rent a small studio near the MRT station.
ex.zh: 我在捷運站附近租了一間小套房。

ex.en: A studio in this area costs about 15,000 dollars a month.
ex.zh: 這一區的套房一個月大約一萬五千元。

studio.en: a small apartment with one main room for living and sleeping

ex.en: I am strongly opposed to a compromise.
ex.zh: 我強烈反對妥協。

ex.en: Mariko's parents are strongly opposed to her marrying an American.
ex.zh: 麻理子的父母強烈反對她嫁給美國人。

ex.en: I strongly recommend this restaurant.
ex.zh: 我強力推薦這家餐廳。

strongly.en: in a very firm and serious way

ex.en: He stretched out his arm to take the book.
ex.zh: 他伸長手臂去拿那本書。

ex.en: You have to stretch your muscles after swimming in the pool.
ex.zh: 在泳池游完泳後要伸展肌肉。

ex.en: Stand up and stretch every hour.
ex.zh: 每小時起來伸展一下。

stretch.en: to make your body or a part of it reach out to its full length

ex.en: The beach stretches for miles along the coast.
ex.zh: 海灘沿著海岸綿延好幾英里。

ex.en: The traffic jam stretched for three kilometers.
ex.zh: 車陣綿延了三公里。

stretch.en: to cover a long distance or area

ex.en: On the border, there is a stretch of agricultural land.
ex.zh: 邊境上有一片農地。

ex.en: This stretch of road is very dangerous at night.
ex.zh: 這段路晚上很危險。

stretch.en: a long area of land or water, or a period of time

ex.en: Our stuff got stolen, and we missed our train.
ex.zh: 我們的東西被偷了，還錯過了火車。

ex.en: The sight of the money tempted him into stealing.
ex.zh: 看到那筆錢，他忍不住偷了。

ex.en: Someone stole my bike last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚有人偷了我的腳踏車。

steal.en: to take something that belongs to someone else without permission

ex.en: The two men were seen to steal into the house.
ex.zh: 有人看到那兩個人偷偷溜進房子裡。

ex.en: She stole a glance at her phone during the meeting.
ex.zh: 她開會時偷瞄了一眼手機。

steal.en: to move quietly so that no one notices

ex.en: At this price, the laptop is a steal.
ex.zh: 這個價格買這台筆電簡直超划算。

ex.en: This jacket was a steal at only $20.
ex.zh: 這件外套只要 20 美元，真是撿到便宜。

steal.en: something that costs much less than it is worth

ex.en: A stable economy is the aim of every government.
ex.zh: 穩定的經濟是每個政府的目標。

ex.en: He is a man of strong, stable and trustworthy character.
ex.zh: 他是個性格堅強、沉穩又值得信賴的人。

ex.en: The patient is now in stable condition.
ex.zh: 病人目前情況穩定。

stable.en: firm and not likely to change or fall

ex.en: The horses are kept in the stable.
ex.zh: 馬養在馬廄裡。

ex.en: He cleans the stables every morning.
ex.zh: 他每天早上清理馬廄。

stable.en: a building where horses are kept

ex.en: It seems that there will be a storm soon.
ex.zh: 看來快要有暴風雨了。

ex.en: We had to stay home because of the storm.
ex.zh: 因為暴風雨，我們只好待在家裡。

ex.en: I'm stuck here in Boston because of the storm.
ex.zh: 因為暴風雨，我被困在波士頓。

storm.en: very bad weather with strong wind and heavy rain or snow

ex.en: She stormed out of the meeting.
ex.zh: 她氣沖沖地離開會議。

ex.en: He stormed into my office without knocking.
ex.zh: 他沒敲門就氣沖沖地衝進我的辦公室。

storm.en: to go somewhere in a very angry way

ex.en: She tied up the parcel with string.
ex.zh: 她用繩子把包裹綁好。

ex.en: Tom attached the string to the kite.
ex.zh: 湯姆把線綁在風箏上。

string.en: thin rope used for tying things

ex.en: A string of disasters struck the region.
ex.zh: 一連串的災難襲擊了這個地區。

ex.en: We received a string of complaints last week.
ex.zh: 我們上週接到一連串的投訴。

string.en: a number of similar things that happen one after another

ex.en: He can pull strings for you.
ex.zh: 他可以幫你動用關係。

ex.en: She pulled strings to get her son a job.
ex.zh: 她動用關係幫兒子找到工作。

string.en: to use your influence to get what you want

ex.en: Tom strung a clothesline between the two trees.
ex.zh: 湯姆在兩棵樹之間掛起一條曬衣繩。

ex.en: We strung lights around the Christmas tree.
ex.zh: 我們在聖誕樹上掛了一圈燈。

string.en: to hang something up, or to put things on a thread

ex.en: It is rude to stare at strangers.
ex.zh: 盯著陌生人看是不禮貌的。

ex.en: My manager stared at me as if he was angry.
ex.zh: 經理盯著我看，好像生氣了。

ex.en: Nothing is better than staring at the night sky.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼比凝望夜空更美好的了。

stare.en: to look at someone or something for a long time without looking away

ex.en: There was a steady increase in population.
ex.zh: 人口穩定增加。

ex.en: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.
ex.zh: 他以穩健的步伐走上山坡。

ex.en: Do you have a steady boyfriend?
ex.zh: 你有固定交往的男朋友嗎？

steady.en: regular and continuing without sudden changes

ex.en: He steadied himself against the wall.
ex.zh: 他扶著牆穩住身子。

ex.en: She took a deep breath to steady her nerves.
ex.zh: 她深吸一口氣讓自己鎮定下來。

steady.en: to make something stop shaking and stay firm

ex.en: The stream flows into the pond.
ex.zh: 溪水流進池塘。

ex.en: The stream is not very swift.
ex.zh: 水流不太湍急。

ex.en: A stream of people came out of the theater.
ex.zh: 一大群人從劇院湧出。

ex.en: The shop has a steady stream of customers.
ex.zh: 這家店的客人源源不絕。

stream.en: a continuous flow of people or things

ex.en: You can stream the movie online.
ex.zh: 你可以在網路上串流觀看這部電影。

ex.en: The concert will be streamed live.
ex.zh: 這場演唱會將會線上直播。

stream.en: to watch or listen to something over the internet without saving it

ex.en: Tom has been under a great deal of strain lately.
ex.zh: 湯姆最近壓力非常大。

ex.en: Working long hours puts a strain on your health.
ex.zh: 長時間工作會對健康造成負擔。

strain.en: worry or pressure caused by a difficult situation

ex.en: I strained my back while moving the boxes.
ex.zh: 我搬箱子時拉傷了背。

ex.en: Don't strain your eyes by reading in the dark.
ex.zh: 別在暗處看書，會讓眼睛太累。

strain.en: to hurt a muscle by using it too much, or to make something work too hard

ex.en: The rope broke under the strain.
ex.zh: 繩子承受不住拉力而斷了。

ex.en: The bridge is designed to withstand great strain.
ex.zh: 這座橋的設計能承受巨大的拉力。

strain.en: a force that pulls on something very hard

ex.en: Their trouble stems from a trifling matter.
ex.zh: 他們的煩惱起因於一件小事。

ex.en: From what stems this contradiction between our hopes and our reality?
ex.zh: 我們的期望和現實之間的落差從何而來？

stem.en: to come from or be caused by something

ex.en: Cut the stems of the flowers before putting them in water.
ex.zh: 把花插進水裡之前先修剪花莖。

ex.en: The stem of this plant is very thin.
ex.zh: 這株植物的莖很細。

stem.en: the long thin part of a plant that carries the flowers and leaves

ex.en: I want to slice these potatoes into strips.
ex.zh: 我想把這些馬鈴薯切成條。

ex.en: Cut the paper into thin strips.
ex.zh: 把紙剪成細條。

strip.en: a long narrow piece of something

ex.en: Tom was stripped to the waist.
ex.zh: 湯姆打著赤膊。

ex.en: We stripped the old paint off the walls.
ex.zh: 我們把牆上的舊油漆刮掉了。

strip.en: to take off a covering, or to take off clothes

ex.en: The aviation expert analyzed the statistics in detail.
ex.zh: 航空專家詳細分析了統計資料。

ex.en: Facts are stubborn things, but statistics are pliable.
ex.zh: 事實是頑固的，但統計數字卻很有彈性。

ex.en: Statistics show that more people are working from home.
ex.zh: 統計數字顯示，越來越多人在家工作。

statistic.en: a number that gives a fact about something

ex.en: I'm not as stupid as you think I am.
ex.zh: 我沒有你想的那麼笨。

ex.en: It is stupid of you to believe in him.
ex.zh: 你竟然相信他，真是太傻了。

ex.en: My parents keep arguing about stupid things. It's so annoying!
ex.zh: 我爸媽老是為了芝麻小事吵架，煩死了！

stupid.en: not showing good sense or intelligence

ex.en: An elderly person in my family suddenly fell to the ground; he likely suffered a stroke.
ex.zh: 我家一位長輩突然倒在地上，可能是中風了。

ex.en: My grandfather had a stroke last year.
ex.zh: 我爺爺去年中風了。

stroke.en: a sudden medical problem in the brain that can cause loss of movement

ex.en: This character has ten strokes.
ex.zh: 這個字有十畫。

ex.en: Practice the strokes in the correct order.
ex.zh: 照正確的筆順練習筆畫。

stroke.en: a single line made with one movement of a pen when writing a character

stroke.zh: a stroke of luck：意外的好運

ex.en: It was a stroke of luck that we found a taxi.
ex.zh: 我們能叫到計程車真是運氣好。

ex.en: By a stroke of luck, the meeting was postponed.
ex.zh: 很幸運地，會議延期了。

stroke.en: a lucky event that happens by chance

ex.en: She gently stroked the cat.
ex.zh: 她輕輕地撫摸那隻貓。

ex.en: He stroked his chin and thought for a while.
ex.zh: 他摸著下巴想了一會兒。

stroke.en: to move your hand gently over something

stake.zh: at stake：面臨風險、攸關成敗

ex.en: I felt that my honor was at stake.
ex.zh: 我覺得我的名譽岌岌可危。

ex.en: There is a lot of money at stake in this deal.
ex.zh: 這筆交易牽涉到很多錢。

stake.en: in danger of being lost, depending on the result

ex.en: The company holds a 20% stake in the startup.
ex.zh: 這家公司持有那間新創公司 20% 的股份。

ex.en: Employees have a stake in the company's success.
ex.zh: 員工和公司的成功息息相關。

stake.en: a share in a business, or a personal interest in something

ex.en: I'll stake my reputation on it.
ex.zh: 我敢拿我的名聲打包票。

ex.en: He staked everything on the new business.
ex.zh: 他把一切都押在這門新生意上。

stake.en: to risk something valuable on the result of something

ex.en: It will also help to strengthen the city's economy.
ex.zh: 這也有助於強化城市的經濟。

ex.en: Swimming strengthens the legs.
ex.zh: 游泳能強化腿部肌肉。

ex.en: We need to strengthen our relationship with key clients.
ex.zh: 我們需要加強與主要客戶的關係。

ex.en: There is no need to be so strict.
ex.zh: 不用這麼嚴格。

ex.en: Don't be too strict. They're just kids.
ex.zh: 別太嚴格，他們只是小孩子。

ex.en: The contest has very strict eligibility requirements.
ex.zh: 這項比賽的參賽資格要求非常嚴格。

ex.en: Mary is on a strict diet, isn't she?
ex.zh: 瑪麗正在嚴格節食，對吧？

ex.en: Tom used to be a strict vegetarian.
ex.zh: 湯姆以前是個嚴格的素食者。

strict.en: following rules or a plan exactly, with no exceptions

ex.en: Investors are looking for economic stability.
ex.zh: 投資人在尋求經濟穩定。

ex.en: The job offers good pay and stability.
ex.zh: 這份工作薪水好又穩定。

ex.en: This update improves the stability of the app.
ex.zh: 這次更新提升了 App 的穩定性。

stability.en: the condition of not changing or failing

ex.en: Tax cuts are often used as a major fiscal tool to stimulate the economy.
ex.zh: 減稅常被當作刺激經濟的主要財政手段。

ex.en: Low interest rates can stimulate spending.
ex.zh: 低利率能刺激消費。

stimulate.en: to make something grow or become more active

ex.en: Coffee and tea stimulate me.
ex.zh: 咖啡和茶會讓我精神振奮。

ex.en: Good teachers stimulate students to think.
ex.zh: 好老師會激發學生思考。

stimulate.en: to make someone feel excited, awake or full of energy

ex.en: The old lady climbed the stairs with difficulty.
ex.zh: 那位老太太吃力地爬上樓梯。

ex.en: I slipped and fell down the stairs.
ex.zh: 我滑倒，從樓梯上摔了下來。

ex.en: My house has two flights of stairs.
ex.zh: 我家有兩段樓梯。

stair.en: a set of steps that go from one level of a building to another

ex.en: You should especially not drink on an empty stomach.
ex.zh: 你尤其不該空腹喝酒。

ex.en: The pain is here, right? That's a stomach ache.
ex.zh: 是這裡痛嗎？那是胃痛。

ex.en: Do you feel any pain in your stomach?
ex.zh: 你胃會痛嗎？

stomach.en: the organ in your body where food goes after you swallow it, or the belly

ex.en: I can't stomach his rude jokes.
ex.zh: 我受不了他粗魯的玩笑。

ex.en: She couldn't stomach the idea of working overtime again.
ex.zh: 她無法忍受又要加班。

stomach.en: to be able to accept something unpleasant

ex.en: Don't forget to put a stamp on your letter.
ex.zh: 別忘了在信上貼郵票。

ex.en: You can buy stamps at any post office.
ex.zh: 你在任何一家郵局都能買到郵票。

ex.en: John likes to trade stamps with his friends.
ex.zh: 約翰喜歡和朋友交換郵票。

stamp.en: a small piece of paper you stick on a letter to pay for posting it

ex.en: The officer put a stamp in my passport.
ex.zh: 官員在我的護照上蓋了章。

ex.en: You need the manager's stamp on this form.
ex.zh: 這份表格需要經理蓋章。

stamp.en: a tool or mark that prints a name, date or sign on paper

ex.en: Please stamp the date on each document.
ex.zh: 請在每份文件上蓋上日期章。

ex.en: He stamped his feet to keep warm.
ex.zh: 他跺腳取暖。

stamp.en: to press a mark onto paper, or to bring your foot down hard

ex.en: She stirred her coffee with a teaspoon.
ex.zh: 她用茶匙攪拌咖啡。

ex.en: Stir the soup.
ex.zh: 攪拌一下湯。

stir.en: to mix a liquid or food by moving a spoon around in it

ex.en: A breeze stirred the leaves.
ex.zh: 微風吹動了樹葉。

ex.en: A light breeze stirred the surface of the lake.
ex.zh: 微風吹過湖面，泛起漣漪。

stir.en: to move slightly, or to make something move slightly

stir.zh: 激起、引起（常用 stir up）

ex.en: I don't want to stir up old memories.
ex.zh: 我不想勾起往事。

ex.en: His comments stirred up a lot of debate.
ex.zh: 他的言論引發了許多爭論。

stir.en: to cause a feeling or memory to start

ex.en: The new phone caused quite a stir.
ex.zh: 這款新手機造成不小的轟動。

ex.en: Her speech created a stir online.
ex.zh: 她的演講在網路上引起轟動。

stir.en: a state of excitement or interest among people

ex.en: How do you clean oil stains off clothes?
ex.zh: 衣服沾到油漬要怎麼洗？

ex.en: Do you have anything to remove stains?
ex.zh: 你有去汙漬的東西嗎？

stain.en: a dirty mark that is difficult to remove

ex.en: His shirt was stained with sauce.
ex.zh: 他的襯衫沾到了醬汁。

ex.en: A drop of mustard fell and stained my tie during lunch.
ex.zh: 午餐時一滴芥末醬掉下來，弄髒了我的領帶。

stain.en: to leave a dirty mark on something

ex.en: Engineers found structural damage after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 工程師在地震後發現結構損壞。

ex.en: The company is going through structural changes.
ex.zh: 公司正在進行結構性變革。

structural.en: relating to the way something is built or arranged

ex.en: It is a stereotype that police officers always eat doughnuts.
ex.zh: 警察總是吃甜甜圈是一種刻板印象。

ex.en: This film attempts to break stereotypes and redefine what true masculinity is.
ex.zh: 這部電影試圖打破刻板印象，重新定義真正的男子氣概。

stereotype.en: a fixed idea about a type of person that is often not true

ex.en: Don't stereotype people based on their age.
ex.zh: 不要因為年齡就對人有刻板印象。

ex.en: Older workers are often stereotyped as slow with technology.
ex.zh: 年長員工常被貼上不擅長科技的標籤。

stereotype.en: to think that all people of a type are the same, often wrongly

ex.en: Because of the blizzard, Tom and Mary were stranded in Boston.
ex.zh: 因為暴風雪，湯姆和瑪麗被困在波士頓。

ex.en: Hundreds of passengers were stranded at the airport.
ex.zh: 數百名旅客滯留在機場。

strand.en: to leave someone in a place they cannot leave

ex.en: A strand of hair fell across her face.
ex.zh: 一縷頭髮垂到她臉上。

ex.en: DNA consists of two strands.
ex.zh: DNA 由兩股鏈組成。

strand.en: a single thin piece of thread or hair

ex.en: The steward brought us blankets during the flight.
ex.zh: 飛行途中，空服員為我們送上毯子。

ex.en: Ask the steward if you need anything.
ex.zh: 需要什麼的話請詢問服務員。

steward.en: a person who looks after passengers on a plane or ship

ex.en: We are stewards of the company's resources.
ex.zh: 我們是公司資源的管理者。

ex.en: The steward managed the estate for the family.
ex.zh: 那位管家為這個家族管理莊園。

steward.en: a person who looks after property or things for others

ex.en: I was stung by a bee.
ex.zh: 我被蜜蜂螫了一下。

ex.en: I've just been stung by a bee.
ex.zh: 我剛剛被蜜蜂螫了。

ex.en: The smoke made my eyes sting.
ex.zh: 煙讓我的眼睛刺痛。

sting.en: to hurt someone with a small sharp point, or to cause a sharp pain

ex.en: I got a bee sting.
ex.zh: 我被蜜蜂螫了一下。

ex.en: Bee stings can be very painful.
ex.zh: 被蜜蜂螫到可能非常痛。

ex.en: She put some cream on the sting.
ex.zh: 她在螫傷處擦了些藥膏。

sting.en: a sharp pain or small wound caused by an insect or plant

stopover.zh: （旅途中的）短暫停留、中途停留

ex.en: We had a stopover in Chicago.
ex.zh: 我們中途在芝加哥停留了一下。

ex.en: Our flight to London has a stopover in Dubai.
ex.zh: 我們飛倫敦的班機會在杜拜中途停留。

ex.en: We decided to enjoy a two-day stopover in Tokyo.
ex.zh: 我們決定在東京停留兩天。

stopover.en: a short stay in a place during a long journey

ex.en: English people rarely talk to strangers on trains.
ex.zh: 英國人在火車上很少和陌生人說話。

ex.en: I am very ill at ease with strangers.
ex.zh: 我跟陌生人在一起時很不自在。

ex.en: He treats me as if I am a stranger.
ex.zh: 他把我當成陌生人來看待。

stranger.en: a person you do not know

ex.en: She gets along well with her stepmother.
ex.zh: 她和繼母相處得很好。

ex.en: In the story, Cinderella lives with her cruel stepmother.
ex.zh: 故事裡，灰姑娘跟她殘忍的繼母住在一起。

stepmother.en: the woman who is married to your father but is not your birth mother

ex.en: There has been a lot of stress at work lately.
ex.zh: 最近工作壓力很大。

ex.en: She is unable to cope with stress.
ex.zh: 她無法應付壓力。

stress.en: worry that comes from problems in your life

ex.en: I'm always stressed out.
ex.zh: 我總是壓力很大。

ex.en: She's stressed about her exams.
ex.zh: 她為了考試壓力很大。

stress.en: feeling very worried and unable to relax

ex.en: He stressed the convenient aspects of city life.
ex.zh: 他強調都市生活的便利。

ex.en: The teacher stressed the importance of practice.
ex.zh: 老師強調練習的重要性。

stress.en: to say that something is very important

ex.en: Where do you place the stress in the word "Australia"?
ex.zh: 「Australia」這個字的重音在哪裡？

ex.en: The stress is on the second syllable.
ex.zh: 重音在第二個音節。

stress.en: the force you put on part of a word when you say it

ex.en: My parents say that YouTube and streaming services cheapen the magic of film.
ex.zh: 我爸媽說，YouTube 和串流平台讓電影失去了魔力。

ex.en: I watch most shows on streaming services now.
ex.zh: 我現在大多用串流平台看節目。

streaming.en: a way of watching or listening to something over the internet as it arrives

ex.en: Avoid sudden movements around the rabbit, they can startle them.
ex.zh: 避免在兔子旁邊突然做出動作，以免嚇到牠們。

ex.en: This startled me.
ex.zh: 這驚到我了。

ex.en: The sudden noise startled the baby.
ex.zh: 突然的聲響嚇到了嬰兒。

startle.en: to give someone a sudden small shock

ex.en: The teacher gave his pupils a stern telling-off.
ex.zh: 老師把學生狠狠地罵了一頓。

ex.en: The teacher gave the noisy class a stern look.
ex.zh: 老師對吵鬧的班級投以嚴厲的眼神。

ex.en: I have never come across such a stubborn person.
ex.zh: 我從來沒碰到過這麼倔的人。

ex.en: Why are you being so stubborn?
ex.zh: 你為什麼這麼倔？

ex.en: He is a stubborn person.
ex.zh: 他是個倔強的人。

ex.en: The drunk man staggered down the street.
ex.zh: 醉漢搖搖晃晃地走在街上。

ex.en: She staggered under the weight of the heavy bag.
ex.zh: 她被沉重的袋子壓得步履蹣跚。

stagger.en: to walk in an unsteady way as if about to fall

ex.en: The beggar is collecting stale bread.
ex.zh: 這名乞丐在收集乾麵包。

ex.en: The beer is stale.
ex.zh: 啤酒沒氣了。

ex.en: The bread was stale after a week in the cupboard.
ex.zh: 麵包在櫥櫃裡放了一週後就不新鮮了。

stale.en: no longer fresh, especially for bread

ex.en: He is very stingy with his money.
ex.zh: 他非常吝嗇。

ex.en: Tom is stingy.
ex.zh: 湯姆很小氣。

ex.en: Mary doesn't like men who are stingy like Tom.
ex.zh: 瑪莉不喜歡跟湯姆一樣吝嗇的男人。

stingy.en: not willing to spend or give money

streak.zh: 一系列、一連串（的好運或壞運）

ex.en: The team is on a five-game winning streak.
ex.zh: 這支球隊正處於五連勝。

ex.en: He is having a streak of bad luck.
ex.zh: 他最近一直走霉運。

streak.en: a period of continuous good or bad luck or success

ex.en: Her hair is streaked with gray.
ex.zh: 她的頭髮中夾有白髮。

ex.en: Tears streaked her face.
ex.zh: 淚水在她臉上留下一道道痕跡。

streak.en: to mark with long thin lines, or to run very fast

ex.en: Wages have remained stagnant for several years.
ex.zh: 薪資已經停滯了好幾年。

ex.en: The stagnant economy made it hard to find a job.
ex.zh: 經濟不景氣讓人很難找到工作。

ex.en: Mosquitoes breed in stagnant water.
ex.zh: 蚊子會在不流動的積水中繁殖。

ex.en: Open the window; the air in here is stagnant.
ex.zh: 開個窗吧，這裡的空氣都不流通。

stagnant.en: not moving or flowing, and often smelling bad

ex.en: Although he is small in stature, he is a strong basketball player.
ex.zh: 雖然他個子不高，卻是個很強的籃球員。

ex.en: She was a woman of average stature with short dark hair.
ex.zh: 她是個身高中等、留著黑色短髮的女人。

ex.en: The scientist's stature grew after she won the international award.
ex.zh: 這位科學家獲得國際大獎後，聲望更高了。

ex.en: Few politicians have the stature to unite the whole country.
ex.zh: 很少有政治人物有足夠的威望來團結全國。

stature.en: the respect and importance that a person has

ex.en: She treats her stepchild just like her own daughter.
ex.zh: 她對待繼女就像對待自己的女兒一樣。

ex.en: Being a good stepparent takes time, and every stepchild needs patience.
ex.zh: 要當好繼父母需要時間，每個繼子女都需要耐心對待。

stepchild.en: the child of your husband or wife from an earlier relationship

ex.en: The statute was passed in 1990.
ex.zh: 這項法令於 1990 年通過。

ex.en: Under the statute, companies must report their emissions.
ex.zh: 根據法規，企業必須申報排放量。

statute.en: a written law made by a government

ex.en: Stagflation is a mix of high inflation and slow growth.
ex.zh: 停滯性通膨是高通膨加上經濟成長緩慢。

ex.en: Economists warn of possible stagflation next year.
ex.zh: 經濟學家警告明年可能出現停滯性通膨。

stagflation.en: a situation in which prices rise but the economy does not grow

ex.en: We tried to come up to the standard.
ex.zh: 我們努力達到標準。

ex.en: This school sets high moral standards for pupils.
ex.zh: 這個學校對學生的道德標準要求很高。

ex.en: However, other aspects have already surpassed the standards of many Western countries.
ex.zh: 不過，其他方面已經超越了許多西方國家的水準。

standard.en: a level of quality that people expect or measure things against

ex.en: I would like to learn standard English.
ex.zh: 我想學標準的英語。

ex.en: Standard Chinese, commonly referred to as Mandarin, is based on Pekinese.
ex.zh: 標準中文，也就是一般所說的普通話，是以北京話為基礎。

standard.en: normal and usual, or accepted as correct

ex.en: I began to doubt the accuracy of his statement.
ex.zh: 我開始懷疑他陳述的準確性。

ex.en: I would like to retract my previous statement.
ex.zh: 我想撤回我之前的說法。

ex.en: The family was highly doubtful of the statement from the military.
ex.zh: 家屬對軍方的說法高度懷疑。

statement.en: something that you say or write officially to give information

ex.en: I get a bank statement every month.
ex.zh: 我每個月會收到銀行對帳單。

ex.en: Check your credit card statement for errors.
ex.zh: 檢查一下信用卡帳單有沒有錯。

statement.en: a printed record of money paid into and out of a bank account

ex.en: He invested his money in stocks.
ex.zh: 他把錢投資在股票上。

ex.en: He lost a fortune in the stock market.
ex.zh: 他在股市賠了一大筆錢。

ex.en: This company is listed on the Paris stock exchange.
ex.zh: 這家公司在巴黎證券交易所上市。

stock.en: a share in the ownership of a company

ex.en: We have plenty of stock in the warehouse.
ex.zh: 倉庫裡存貨充足。

ex.en: That model is no longer in stock.
ex.zh: 那個型號已經沒有庫存了。

stock.en: the goods that a shop or business has available to sell

ex.en: The store stocks a wide range of organic food.
ex.zh: 這家店有賣各式各樣的有機食品。

ex.en: We need to stock up on water before the typhoon.
ex.zh: 颱風來之前我們需要多囤點水。

stock.en: to keep goods available to sell

ex.en: Please store the files in the storage cabinet.
ex.zh: 請把檔案收進收納櫃。

ex.en: The storage cabinet is beside the printer.
ex.zh: 收納櫃就在印表機旁邊。

storage cabinet.en: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves for keeping things

ex.en: From the supplier’s standpoint, the revised schedule is difficult to meet.
ex.zh: 從供應商的角度來看，修訂後的時程很難配合。

ex.en: The report considers the safety issue from both the workers’ and managers’ standpoints.
ex.zh: 這份報告從員工與主管雙方的角度探討安全問題。

standpoint.en: a way of thinking about a subject

ex.en: Interns receive a monthly stipend for transportation.
ex.zh: 實習生每月可領取交通津貼。

ex.en: The research stipend covers basic living costs.
ex.zh: 研究津貼可支付基本生活費。

stipend.en: a small regular payment given to someone for their work or studies

ex.en: The manufacturer stockpiled essential components before the supplier’s factory closed for the holiday.
ex.zh: 供應商工廠假期停工前，製造商先儲備了必要零件。

ex.en: Hospitals were asked not to stockpile protective equipment beyond their needs.
ex.zh: 醫院接獲通知，不要囤積超出需求的防護設備。

stockpile.en: to collect and keep a large supply of something for future use

ex.en: The shop closed for half a day while staff completed the annual stocktaking.
ex.zh: 店員進行年度盤點，店面因此暫停營業半天。

ex.en: Stocktaking revealed that several high-value items were missing.
ex.zh: 盤點結果顯示有幾件高價商品短少。

stocktaking.en: the process of counting all the goods a business has

ex.en: The extra supplies are kept in the stockroom.
ex.zh: 多出的用品都放在庫房裡。

ex.en: Please check the stockroom before ordering more boxes.
ex.zh: 再訂紙箱之前，請先檢查庫房。

stockroom.en: a room where a shop or business keeps its goods

ex.en: A narrow staircase leads to the apartment"s attic.
ex.zh: 一座狹窄的樓梯通往公寓閣樓。

ex.en: The hotel installed a handrail along the marble staircase.
ex.zh: 飯店沿著大理石樓梯加裝扶手。

staircase.en: a set of steps with a rail that goes between levels of a building

ex.en: The bakery renovated its storefront to attract more pedestrians.
ex.zh: 麵包店翻新店面，吸引更多路人。

ex.en: A vacant storefront is available for lease on the corner.
ex.zh: 轉角有一間空店面正在出租。

storefront.en: the front of a shop that faces the street

ex.en: National rescue teams are on standby ready to fly to Japan.
ex.zh: 各國救難隊都在待命，隨時準備飛往日本。

ex.en: The hospital keeps a generator on standby in case of a power outage.
ex.zh: 醫院準備了一台備用發電機，以防停電。

standby.en: the state of being ready to act if needed

ex.en: We're on standby for the next flight to Seoul.
ex.zh: 我們在候補下一班飛往首爾的班機。

ex.en: Standby passengers can board only if there are empty seats.
ex.zh: 候補旅客只有在還有空位時才能登機。

standby.en: a way of traveling in which you wait for an empty seat at the last minute

ex.en: Go straight on to the end of the road.
ex.zh: 一直直走到這條路的盡頭。

ex.en: Go straight for two blocks.
ex.zh: 直走兩個街區。

straight.en: in a direct line without turning

ex.en: He drew a straight line on the wall.
ex.zh: 他在牆上畫了一條直線。

ex.en: Tom drew a straight line on the paper.
ex.zh: 湯姆在紙上畫了一道直線。

ex.en: He was ill in bed for four days straight.
ex.zh: 他一連四天臥病在床。

ex.en: It rained for three days straight.
ex.zh: 連續下了三天雨。

straight.en: one after another with no break

ex.en: You may stay here as long as you like.
ex.zh: 你想在這兒待多久就待多久。

ex.en: I would rather stay at home than go out.
ex.zh: 比起出門，我更喜歡待在家。

stay.en: to remain in a place and not leave

ex.en: We stayed at a small hotel near the station.
ex.zh: 我們住在車站附近的一間小旅館。

ex.en: How long will you be staying in Japan?
ex.zh: 你會在日本待多久？

stay.en: to live somewhere for a short time as a guest

ex.en: Enjoy your stay!
ex.zh: 祝您住宿愉快！

ex.en: During my stay in London, I visited many museums.
ex.zh: 我在倫敦停留期間參觀了很多博物館。

stay.en: a period of time spent in a place

ex.en: I thoroughly regretted staying up so late, come morning.
ex.zh: 到了早上，我非常後悔昨晚熬夜到那麼晚。

ex.en: I stayed up all night finishing my report.
ex.zh: 我熬了一整夜把報告寫完。

stay.en: to not go to bed at the usual time

stolen.zh: 被偷的（steal 的過去分詞）

ex.en: I had my wallet stolen on the bus.
ex.zh: 我的錢包在公車上被偷了。

ex.en: He had his car stolen in broad daylight.
ex.zh: 他的車在光天化日之下被偷走了。

ex.en: Our stuff got stolen, and we missed our train.
ex.zh: 我們的東西被偷走了，而且我們錯過了火車。

stolen.en: to be taken without the owner's permission

ex.en: Obviously, they are jealous of his wealth and status.
ex.zh: 他們很明顯在嫉妒他的財富和地位。

ex.en: I believe that a fine education can change one's social status.
ex.zh: 我相信良好的教育能改變人的社會地位。

status.en: a person's position or rank in society

ex.en: Can you tell me about your marital status?
ex.zh: 能告訴我你的婚姻狀況嗎？

ex.en: What's the status of my order?
ex.zh: 我的訂單現在是什麼狀態？

status.en: the condition of someone or something at a particular time

ex.en: The new system will streamline our ordering process.
ex.zh: 新系統能簡化我們的訂購流程。

ex.en: We streamlined the application form to just one page.
ex.zh: 我們把申請表簡化到只有一頁。

streamline.en: to make a process simpler and more efficient

ex.en: We should get feedback from all stakeholders.
ex.zh: 我們應該聽取所有利害關係人的意見。

ex.en: Customers and employees are key stakeholders.
ex.zh: 顧客和員工都是重要的利害關係人。

stakeholder.en: a person or group with an interest in a business or project

ex.en: What is your stance on remote work?
ex.zh: 你對遠距工作的立場是什麼？

ex.en: The company took a firm stance against discrimination.
ex.zh: 公司對歧視採取堅決反對的立場。

stance.en: an opinion that someone has and shows publicly

ex.en: The contract stipulates that payment must be made within 30 days.
ex.zh: 合約規定必須在 30 天內付款。

ex.en: The rules stipulate a maximum of two bags per person.
ex.zh: 規定每人最多兩件行李。

stipulate.en: to say clearly that something must be done

ex.en: Our staff will contact you in three working days.
ex.zh: 我們的工作人員會在三個工作日內聯絡您。

ex.en: The staff in that restaurant gave us a very good impression.
ex.zh: 那家餐廳的服務人員給我們留下很好的印象。

ex.en: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.
ex.zh: 整個業務團隊連續一週日夜加班。

staff.en: all the people who work for a company or organization

ex.en: All of this stationery is his.
ex.zh: 這些都是他的文具。

ex.en: What stationery isn't worth buying?
ex.zh: 哪些文具不值得買？

stationery.en: things used for writing, such as paper and pens

ex.en: Because your business can play to my strengths.
ex.zh: 因為貴公司的業務能發揮我的長處。

ex.en: To remain competitive, we've got to play to our strengths.
ex.zh: 為了保持競爭力，我們得發揮我們的優勢。

strength.en: a good quality or skill that someone has

ex.en: I don't have the strength to keep trying.
ex.zh: 我沒力氣繼續嘗試了。

ex.en: He didn't have the strength to lift the box.
ex.zh: 他沒有力氣抬起那個箱子。

strength.en: the physical power of a person's body

ex.en: I take the stairs instead of the elevator for exercise.
ex.zh: 我為了運動而走樓梯，不搭電梯。

ex.en: She ran up the stairs to answer the phone.
ex.zh: 她跑上樓梯去接電話。

ex.en: The baby cannot climb the stairs yet.
ex.zh: 這個寶寶還不會爬樓梯。

ex.en: She has a good standing in the company.
ex.zh: 她在公司裡有不錯的地位。

ex.en: His standing in the community improved after the project.
ex.zh: 那個專案之後，他在社區裡的名聲變好了。

ex.en: There was standing room only on the train.
ex.zh: 火車上只剩下站位。

ex.en: We have a standing appointment every Monday morning.
ex.zh: 我們每週一早上都有固定的約。

ex.en: The starting of the engine made a strange noise.
ex.zh: 引擎啟動時發出奇怪的聲音。

ex.en: Check the starting time of the meeting first.
ex.zh: 先確認會議的開始時間。

ex.en: She has a striking resemblance to her mother.
ex.zh: 她和母親長得驚人地相像。

ex.en: The striking red building stands out on the street.
ex.zh: 那棟醒目的紅色建築在街上特別突出。

ex.en: The striking workers gathered outside the factory.
ex.zh: 罷工的工人聚集在工廠外面。

ex.en: Striking teachers asked for better pay.
ex.zh: 罷工的老師要求更好的薪水。

ex.en: I'll have the soup as a starter.
ex.zh: 我開胃菜要點湯。

ex.en: The starter was good, but the main course was better.
ex.zh: 開胃菜很好吃，但主菜更棒。

ex.en: The car won't start because the starter is broken.
ex.zh: 車子發不動，因為啟動器壞了。

ex.en: He bought a starter kit for his new hobby.
ex.zh: 他為新的嗜好買了入門組。

ex.en: She was the starter in every game this season.
ex.zh: 她這個球季每場比賽都先發。

ex.en: Two starters were injured before the final.
ex.zh: 決賽前有兩位先發球員受傷了。

ex.en: I stumbled on the stairs and almost fell.
ex.zh: 我在樓梯上絆了一下，差點跌倒。

ex.en: The tired runner stumbled across the finish line.
ex.zh: 疲憊的跑者跌跌撞撞地衝過終點線。

ex.en: She stumbled over the difficult words in her speech.
ex.zh: 她在演講中被幾個難字卡住了。

ex.en: The company stumbled in its first year.
ex.zh: 這家公司在第一年就出了差錯。

ex.en: A small stumble cost him the race.
ex.zh: 一個小小的踉蹌讓他輸掉了比賽。

ex.en: She caught herself after a stumble on the path.
ex.zh: 她在小徑上踉蹌了一下，隨即站穩。

ex.en: The striker scored two goals in the final.
ex.zh: 這位前鋒在決賽中進了兩球。

ex.en: Our team needs a new striker this season.
ex.zh: 我們的球隊這個球季需要一位新前鋒。

ex.en: The strikers marched to the city hall.
ex.zh: 罷工者遊行到市政府。

ex.en: Some strikers returned to work on Monday.
ex.zh: 有些罷工者星期一回去上班了。

ex.en: My neck is stiff after sleeping on the sofa.
ex.zh: 睡在沙發上後我的脖子很僵硬。

ex.en: The new shoes are still a bit stiff.
ex.zh: 這雙新鞋還有點硬。

ex.en: The company faces stiff competition from abroad.
ex.zh: 這家公司面臨來自國外的激烈競爭。

ex.en: He received a stiff penalty for cheating.
ex.zh: 他因作弊而受到嚴厲的處罰。

ex.en: He gave a stiff smile and sat down.
ex.zh: 他勉強笑了一下，然後坐下。

ex.en: The conversation was stiff and awkward at first.
ex.zh: 一開始談話既生硬又尷尬。

ex.en: Each stitch on this scarf was sewn by hand.
ex.zh: 這條圍巾的每一針都是手工縫的。

ex.en: The doctor put five stitches in his arm.
ex.zh: 醫生在他的手臂上縫了五針。

ex.en: Can you stitch this button back onto my shirt?
ex.zh: 你可以把這顆鈕扣縫回我的襯衫上嗎？

ex.en: She stitched the torn curtain before hanging it up.
ex.zh: 她把破掉的窗簾縫好之後才掛上去。

ex.en: Can I have a straw for my iced tea?
ex.zh: 我的冰紅茶可以給我一支吸管嗎？

ex.en: Paper straws are replacing plastic ones in many cafés.
ex.zh: 許多咖啡廳正在用紙吸管取代塑膠吸管。

ex.en: The farmer used straw to keep the animals warm.
ex.zh: 農夫用稻草讓動物保暖。

ex.en: A hat made of straw will protect you from the sun.
ex.zh: 稻草編的帽子可以幫你遮太陽。

ex.en: Please turn off the stove before you leave the house.
ex.zh: 出門前請把爐火關掉。

ex.en: A pot of soup is simmering on the stove.
ex.zh: 一鍋湯正在爐子上燉煮。

ex.en: He straightened his tie before the interview.
ex.zh: 面試前他把領帶拉直。

ex.en: She straightened the picture on the wall.
ex.zh: 她把牆上的畫扶正。

ex.en: Let me straighten my desk before we start.
ex.zh: 開始之前讓我先整理一下書桌。

ex.en: We need to straighten out the schedule for next week.
ex.zh: 我們需要把下週的行程整理清楚。

ex.en: The bakery is on Main St. near the bank.
ex.zh: 那家麵包店在銀行附近的主街上。

ex.en: Turn left at Oak St. and walk two blocks.
ex.zh: 在橡樹街左轉，再走兩個街區。

st.zh: 聖（Saint 的縮寫，如 St. Peter）

ex.en: St. Patrick's Day is celebrated every March.
ex.zh: 聖派翠克節每年三月慶祝。

ex.en: We visited St. Paul's Cathedral during our trip.
ex.zh: 我們旅行時參觀了聖保羅大教堂。

states.zh: 說明、陳述（state 的第三人稱單數）

ex.en: The sign states that no pets are allowed.
ex.zh: 告示牌上說明禁止攜帶寵物。

ex.en: She clearly states her opinion in every meeting.
ex.zh: 她在每次會議上都清楚表達自己的意見。

ex.en: The country is made up of fifty states.
ex.zh: 這個國家由五十個州組成。

ex.en: Water can exist in three different states.
ex.zh: 水可以存在於三種不同的狀態。

ex.en: My cousin moved to the States last year.
ex.zh: 我表哥去年搬到了美國。

ex.en: Have you ever been to the States?
ex.zh: 你去過美國嗎？

ex.en: Stephen is a name that comes from an old Greek word.
ex.zh: 斯蒂芬這個名字源自一個古希臘字。

ex.en: Stephen is learning to play the piano this year.
ex.zh: 斯蒂芬今年正在學彈鋼琴。

ex.en: Steve is a short form of the name Stephen.
ex.zh: 史蒂夫是斯蒂芬這個名字的簡稱。

ex.en: Steve fixed our bike chain in just a few minutes.
ex.zh: 史蒂夫只花幾分鐘就修好了我們的腳踏車鏈條。

ex.en: Stuart is training for his first marathon.
ex.zh: 史都華正在為他的第一場馬拉松做訓練。

ex.en: Stuart invited us to his housewarming party.
ex.zh: 史都華邀請我們參加他的喬遷派對。

ex.en: Stewart is writing a report about local birds.
ex.zh: 斯圖爾特正在寫一份關於當地鳥類的報告。

ex.en: Stewart called to say he would be late.
ex.zh: 斯圖爾特打電話來說他會晚到。

ex.en: Stanley is a name that is also used as a surname.
ex.zh: 斯坦利這個名字也被當作姓氏使用。

ex.en: In the picture book, Stanley goes on a trip to the sea.
ex.zh: 在這本繪本裡，斯坦利去海邊旅行。

stuck.zh: 黏住；刺入（stick 的過去式）

ex.en: The stamp stuck firmly to the envelope.
ex.zh: 郵票牢牢地黏在信封上。

ex.en: He stuck a note on the fridge.
ex.zh: 他在冰箱上貼了一張便條。

ex.en: We were stuck in traffic for an hour.
ex.zh: 我們被困在車陣裡一個小時。

ex.en: The door is stuck, and I can't open it.
ex.zh: 這扇門卡住了，我打不開。

ex.en: The view from the mountain top was absolutely stunning.
ex.zh: 山頂上的景色美得令人驚豔。

ex.en: She wore a stunning red dress to the party.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件亮眼的紅色洋裝去參加派對。

ex.en: The team's stunning defeat surprised all the fans.
ex.zh: 球隊令人震驚的落敗讓所有球迷都很意外。

ex.en: We received stunning news about the company this morning.
ex.zh: 我們今天早上收到了關於公司的震撼消息。

ex.en: The sudden news stunned everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 這個突如其來的消息讓房間裡的每個人都愣住了。

ex.en: The size of the crowd stunned the singer.
ex.zh: 觀眾人數之多讓那位歌手大吃一驚。

ex.en: The fall stunned him for a few seconds.
ex.zh: 這一跌讓他暈眩了好幾秒鐘。

ex.en: The loud bang stunned the birds and sent them flying.
ex.zh: 那聲巨響震懾了鳥群，讓牠們四散飛走。

ex.en: Steven drives his little sister to school every morning.
ex.zh: 史蒂文每天早上載他的小妹上學。

ex.en: Steven is saving up to travel around Asia.
ex.zh: 史蒂文正在存錢準備遊歷亞洲。

ex.en: He crossed the street in a few long strides.
ex.zh: 他幾個大步就走過了馬路。

ex.en: Her stride was quick and full of confidence.
ex.zh: 她的步伐輕快又充滿自信。

ex.en: The company has made great strides in clean energy.
ex.zh: 這家公司在潔淨能源上取得了很大的進展。

ex.en: She is making strides in her English.
ex.zh: 她的英文正在穩步進步。

ex.en: He strode into the room and shook everyone's hand.
ex.zh: 他大步走進房間，和每個人握手。

ex.en: The tall man strides down the hall every morning.
ex.zh: 那位高個子男人每天早上都大步走過走廊。

ex.en: He stabbed the potato with a fork to test it.
ex.zh: 他用叉子戳了戳馬鈴薯，看熟了沒。

ex.en: She stabbed her pencil into the paper in anger.
ex.zh: 她生氣地把鉛筆往紙上戳。

ex.en: I'll take a stab at fixing the bike.
ex.zh: 我來試試看能不能修好這輛腳踏車。

ex.en: Let me have a stab at answering the question.
ex.zh: 讓我試著回答這個問題。

ex.en: She put fresh strawberries on top of the cake.
ex.zh: 她把新鮮草莓放在蛋糕上。

ex.en: I would like a strawberry milkshake, please.
ex.zh: 請給我一杯草莓奶昔。

ex.en: We picked strawberries at a farm last weekend.
ex.zh: 上個週末我們去農場採草莓。

ex.en: He sat on a high stool at the kitchen counter.
ex.zh: 他坐在廚房檯面旁的高腳凳上。

ex.en: She stood on a stool to reach the top shelf.
ex.zh: 她站在一張小凳子上去拿最上層架子的東西。

ex.en: The house was strangely quiet when we arrived.
ex.zh: 我們到達時，屋子靜得出奇。

ex.en: He behaved strangely after he came back from the trip.
ex.zh: 他旅行回來後，行為變得很奇怪。

ex.en: Strangely enough, I felt calm during the interview.
ex.zh: 說也奇怪，面試時我反而很平靜。

ex.en: We took a slow stroll along the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐後，我們沿著河邊慢慢散步。

ex.en: A short stroll in the park helped me clear my mind.
ex.zh: 在公園裡散一小段步讓我思緒清晰。

ex.en: They strolled through the old town and looked at the shops.
ex.zh: 他們在老城區漫步，逛著那些商店。

ex.en: He likes to stroll on the beach at sunset.
ex.zh: 他喜歡在日落時在沙灘上漫步。

ex.en: The strap of my bag broke on the way to school.
ex.zh: 我的包包背帶在上學的路上斷了。

ex.en: Please fasten the strap of your helmet.
ex.zh: 請把你的安全帽帶子扣好。

ex.en: He strapped the suitcase onto the roof of the car.
ex.zh: 他用帶子把行李箱綁在車頂上。

ex.en: Nurses strapped the baby into the seat before the trip.
ex.zh: 出發前，護理人員用安全帶把寶寶固定在座椅上。

ex.en: A staffer at the newspaper wrote the report.
ex.zh: 報社的一名職員寫了這篇報導。

ex.en: The senator thanked every staffer who worked late on the project.
ex.zh: 參議員感謝每一位為這個專案加班的職員。

ex.en: She started as a junior staffer and later became an editor.
ex.zh: 她從初階職員做起，後來成為編輯。

ex.en: My hands were sticky from the honey.
ex.zh: 我的手因為蜂蜜而黏黏的。

ex.en: Don't touch the table, it's still sticky.
ex.zh: 別碰那張桌子，它還黏黏的。

ex.en: The children ate sticky rice cakes at the festival.
ex.zh: 孩子們在慶典上吃了黏黏的年糕。

ex.en: It was a hot, sticky night and nobody could sleep.
ex.zh: 那是個悶熱潮濕的夜晚，沒有人睡得著。

ex.en: The summer here is sticky, so I always carry a small towel.
ex.zh: 這裡的夏天又悶又濕，所以我總是帶著一條小毛巾。

ex.en: We are in a sticky situation because the deadline is tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我們陷入了棘手的處境，因為明天就是截止日。

ex.en: That is a sticky question and I need time to think.
ex.zh: 這是個棘手的問題，我需要時間思考。

ex.en: The course has a clear and structured plan.
ex.zh: 這門課有清楚而有組織的計畫。

ex.en: She prefers a structured day with a fixed schedule.
ex.zh: 她喜歡行程固定、有條理的一天。

ex.en: A well structured essay is easier to read.
ex.zh: 結構完整的文章比較好讀。

stockton.zh: 斯托克頓（美國加州城市）

ex.en: Stockton is a city in California.
ex.zh: 斯托克頓是加州的一座城市。

ex.en: The road from Stockton leads north toward Sacramento.
ex.zh: 從斯托克頓出發的公路往北通往沙加緬度。

ex.en: Students take a standardized test at the end of the year.
