ex.en: She starched the shirts so they would stay crisp.
ex.zh: 她把襯衫上了漿，讓它們保持挺括。

ex.en: He starched his collar before the wedding.
ex.zh: 婚禮前他把衣領上了漿。

ex.en: The barrel was made of several wooden staves.
ex.zh: 那個木桶是由幾片木桶板組成的。

ex.en: The notes were written on a five-line stave.
ex.zh: 音符被寫在五線譜上。

ex.en: She ate a banana to stave off hunger until lunch.
ex.zh: 她吃了一根香蕉，好撐到午餐前不餓。

ex.en: The company took steps to stave off bankruptcy.
ex.zh: 公司採取了各種措施來避免破產。

ex.en: I will go to the meeting in his stead.
ex.zh: 我會代替他去開會。

ex.en: She spoke in her sister's stead at the ceremony.
ex.zh: 她在典禮上代替姊姊發言。

stead.zh: 益處；用處（stand in good stead）

ex.en: His early training stood him in good stead later in life.
ex.zh: 他早期的訓練在日後對他大有幫助。

ex.en: Learning to cook will stand you in good stead at college.
ex.zh: 學會做菜在大學裡會對你很有幫助。

ex.en: A strident alarm woke everyone in the building.
ex.zh: 刺耳的警報聲把整棟樓的人都吵醒了。

ex.en: Her strident voice carried across the whole room.
ex.zh: 她尖銳的嗓音傳遍了整個房間。

ex.en: The poster shows a stylized picture of a bird.
ex.zh: 這張海報上有一隻風格化的鳥。

ex.en: The actors used stylized movements on the stage.
ex.zh: 演員在舞台上使用風格化的動作。

ex.en: He tends to stammer when he is nervous.
ex.zh: 他緊張時容易結巴。

ex.en: She began to stammer an excuse.
ex.zh: 她結結巴巴地開始找藉口。

ex.en: He spoke with a slight stammer.
ex.zh: 他說話有輕微的口吃。

ex.en: Therapy helped her overcome her stammer.
ex.zh: 治療幫助她克服了口吃。

ex.en: The streetlight in front of my house turns on at dusk.
ex.zh: 我家門前的路燈在黃昏時會亮起。

ex.en: A moth was circling around the streetlight.
ex.zh: 一隻蛾繞著路燈打轉。

ex.en: He started to stutter when the teacher called his name.
ex.zh: 老師叫到他的名字時，他開始結巴。

ex.en: She stuttered a few words and then stopped.
ex.zh: 她結結巴巴說了幾個字就停下來。

ex.en: He has had a stutter since he was a child.
ex.zh: 他從小就有口吃。

ex.en: The stutter in his voice showed he was scared.
ex.zh: 他聲音裡的結巴顯示他很害怕。

stumbling.zh: 絆倒；跌跌撞撞（stumble 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The boy kept stumbling on the uneven path.
ex.zh: 男孩在凹凸不平的路上不停絆倒。

ex.en: I saw him stumbling home in the dark.
ex.zh: 我看見他在黑暗中跌跌撞撞地走回家。

stumbling.zh: 支支吾吾地說（stumble 的現在分詞）

ex.en: He was stumbling over his words during the speech.
ex.zh: 他演講時說得結結巴巴。

ex.en: She ended up stumbling through her answer.
ex.zh: 她最後支支吾吾地回答。

ex.en: He had two days of stubble on his chin.
ex.zh: 他的下巴上有兩天沒刮的鬍渣。

ex.en: She felt the stubble on his cheek.
ex.zh: 她摸到他臉頰上的鬍渣。

ex.en: The field was covered with wheat stubble.
ex.zh: 田裡滿是收割後留下的麥茬。

ex.en: Farmers burn the stubble after the harvest.
ex.zh: 農夫在收成後燒掉殘株。

ex.en: The film's stereotyped characters were boring.
ex.zh: 這部電影老套的角色很無趣。

ex.en: He gave a stereotyped reply that told us nothing.
ex.zh: 他給了一個千篇一律的回答，什麼資訊都沒有。

ex.en: He is a short, stocky man with strong arms.
ex.zh: 他是個矮壯結實、手臂有力的男人。

ex.en: The stocky wrestler easily lifted the heavy box.
ex.zh: 那位壯碩的摔角選手輕鬆舉起了重箱子。

ex.en: Hawaii gained statehood in 1959.
ex.zh: 夏威夷在 1959 年成為一州。

ex.en: The region's leaders have long campaigned for statehood.
ex.zh: 該地區的領導人長期爭取成為正式的州。

ex.en: The new car has a sleek, streamlined shape.
ex.zh: 這輛新車有光滑的流線型外觀。

ex.en: The company streamlined its process to save time.
ex.zh: 公司精簡了流程以節省時間。

ex.en: The captain ordered everyone to the starboard side of the ship.
ex.zh: 船長命令大家到船的右舷。

ex.en: We saw a small island off the starboard bow.
ex.zh: 我們在船首右舷外看到一座小島。

ex.en: Coffee is a mild stimulant that helps many people wake up.
ex.zh: 咖啡是一種溫和的興奮劑，能幫助許多人清醒。

ex.en: Doctors warn that stimulants can raise your heart rate.
ex.zh: 醫生警告說興奮劑可能讓心跳加快。

stimulant.zh: 興奮性的；有刺激作用的

ex.en: The drink has a stimulant effect on the body.
ex.zh: 這種飲料對身體有刺激的效果。

ex.en: Some herbs have a stimulant action and should be used with care.
ex.zh: 有些草藥有興奮作用，要小心使用。

ex.en: Years of economic stagnation left many people jobless.
ex.zh: 多年的經濟停滯讓許多人失業。

ex.en: He felt a sense of stagnation in his career.
ex.zh: 他覺得自己的事業陷入停滯。

ex.en: Stagnation in the pond caused a bad smell.
ex.zh: 池塘裡的死水發出了難聞的味道。

ex.en: Water stagnation is a common cause of mosquito problems.
ex.zh: 積水不流動是蚊子問題的常見原因。

ex.en: The contract has a stipulation about late payments.
ex.zh: 合約中有一項關於逾期付款的規定。

ex.en: She accepted the job with one stipulation: no weekend work.
ex.zh: 她接受這份工作，但有個條件：週末不上班。

ex.en: The old church is known for its beautiful stonework.
ex.zh: 那座老教堂以精美的石造工藝聞名。

ex.en: Workers repaired the stonework on the castle wall.
ex.zh: 工人們修補了城堡牆上的石造部分。

ex.en: Nurses sterilize the tools before every operation.
ex.zh: 護理師在每次手術前都會為器械消毒。

ex.en: You should sterilize the baby bottles in boiling water.
ex.zh: 你應該用沸水為奶瓶消毒。

ex.en: The vet will sterilize the cat next week.
ex.zh: 獸醫下週會替那隻貓結紮。

ex.en: Many shelters sterilize pets before adoption.
ex.zh: 許多收容所在領養前會為寵物絕育。

ex.en: The classroom was hot and stuffy, so we opened the windows.
ex.zh: 教室又熱又悶，所以我們打開了窗戶。

ex.en: It gets stuffy in here when the air conditioner is off.
ex.zh: 冷氣關掉後，這裡會變得很悶。

ex.en: I have a stuffy nose and can't smell anything.
ex.zh: 我鼻塞，什麼都聞不到。

ex.en: Her stuffy nose made it hard to sleep.
ex.zh: 她鼻子塞住，很難入睡。

ex.en: He has a stuffy way of speaking that bores young people.
ex.zh: 他說話的方式古板，讓年輕人覺得無聊。

ex.en: The dinner was stuffy and formal, so nobody relaxed.
ex.zh: 那場晚宴拘謹又正式，沒有人能放鬆。

ex.en: She looked at him with a steely gaze.
ex.zh: 她以冷硬的目光看著他。

ex.en: The sky turned a steely gray before the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，天空變成鐵灰色。

ex.en: He put out the cigarette stub in the ashtray.
ex.zh: 他把菸蒂在菸灰缸裡捻熄。

ex.en: Please keep your ticket stub in case you need a refund.
ex.zh: 請保留票根，以防需要退款。

ex.en: I stubbed my toe on the table leg.
ex.zh: 我的腳趾撞到了桌腳。

ex.en: He stubbed out his cigarette and walked away.
ex.zh: 他捻熄香菸後便走開了。

ex.en: She is stepping carefully over the wet floor.
ex.zh: 她正小心地跨過濕滑的地板。

ex.en: Stop stepping on my foot!
ex.zh: 別再踩我的腳了！

ex.en: He was stepping out of the car when the phone rang.
ex.zh: 電話響起時，他正要下車。

ex.en: The pitcher got a strikeout to end the inning.
ex.zh: 投手以一次三振結束了這一局。

ex.en: He had ten strikeouts in the game.
ex.zh: 他在那場比賽中投出了十次三振。

ex.en: The door keeps sticking in humid weather.
ex.zh: 這扇門在潮濕的天氣裡老是卡住。

ex.en: Tape is sticking to my fingers.
ex.zh: 膠帶黏在我的手指上。

ex.en: He was sticking a flag into the sand.
ex.zh: 他正把一面旗子插進沙子裡。

ex.en: The child was sticking her tongue out at her brother.
ex.zh: 那個小女孩正對著哥哥吐舌頭。

ex.en: Use a sticking plaster to cover the small cut.
ex.zh: 用黏性的繃帶蓋住那個小傷口。

ex.en: The sticking tape holds the poster on the wall.
ex.zh: 這種黏性膠帶把海報固定在牆上。

ex.en: The captain of the starship gave the order to leave.
ex.zh: 星艦的艦長下令出發。

ex.en: In the movie, a starship travels faster than light.
ex.zh: 電影裡，一艘星艦以超越光速的速度航行。

ex.en: A work stoppage delayed the project by a week.
ex.zh: 一次停工讓專案延後了一週。

ex.en: The train had a stoppage because of a signal problem.
ex.zh: 火車因為號誌問題而停駛。

ex.en: A stoppage in the drain caused the sink to overflow.
ex.zh: 排水管堵塞使水槽溢水。

ex.en: The plumber cleared the stoppage in the pipe.
ex.zh: 水電工疏通了水管的堵塞。

strengthening.zh: 加強；增強（strengthen 的現在分詞）

ex.en: She is strengthening her legs by running every day.
ex.zh: 她每天跑步來強化雙腿。

ex.en: The two countries are strengthening their trade ties.
ex.zh: 這兩國正在加強彼此的貿易關係。

ex.en: The teacher looked sternly at the noisy class.
ex.zh: 老師嚴厲地看著吵鬧的班級。

ex.en: "Come here at once," he said sternly.
ex.zh: 「馬上過來。」他嚴厲地說。

ex.en: The poem has four stanzas of six lines each.
ex.zh: 這首詩有四個詩節，每節六行。

ex.en: She read the second stanza aloud to the class.
ex.zh: 她對全班朗讀了第二節詩。

ex.en: She remained steadfast in her belief that honesty matters.
ex.zh: 她始終堅定相信誠實很重要。

ex.en: He was a steadfast friend during my hardest year.
ex.zh: 在我最艱難的一年，他是個忠實的朋友。

ex.en: The baby grabbed the toy with her stubby little fingers.
ex.zh: 寶寶用她短短胖胖的小手指抓住玩具。

ex.en: He wrote the note with a stubby pencil.
ex.zh: 他用一支短短的鉛筆寫了便條。

ex.en: A lack of funding may stymie the project.
ex.zh: 資金不足可能會阻礙這個計畫。

ex.en: The sudden storm stymied our plans for a picnic.
ex.zh: 突如其來的暴風雨打亂了我們野餐的計畫。

stamped.zh: 蓋章；蓋印（stamp 的過去式）

ex.en: The officer stamped my passport and handed it back.
ex.zh: 官員在我的護照上蓋了章，然後還給我。

ex.en: The date was stamped on the bottom of the box.
ex.zh: 日期被蓋印在盒子的底部。

ex.en: The little boy stamped his feet and refused to leave.
ex.zh: 小男孩用力跺腳，不肯離開。

ex.en: She stamped the snow off her boots before coming in.
ex.zh: 她進屋前先把靴子上的雪跺掉。

ex.en: Please enclose a stamped, self-addressed envelope.
ex.zh: 請附上一個貼好郵票、寫好回信地址的信封。

ex.en: The stamped letter was ready to go in the mailbox.
ex.zh: 那封貼好郵票的信已經可以投進郵筒了。

ex.en: The company wants to standardise its working hours.
ex.zh: 公司想要統一員工的工作時間。

ex.en: Schools should standardise the way they grade tests.
ex.zh: 學校應該統一考試的評分方式。

ex.en: A stacked pile of books stood next to the bed.
ex.zh: 床邊放著一疊疊起來的書。

ex.en: The stacked chairs were put away in the corner.
ex.zh: 疊好的椅子被收在角落。

ex.en: He stacked the boxes against the wall.
ex.zh: 他把箱子靠牆堆起來。

ex.en: The waiter stacked the dirty plates on a tray.
ex.zh: 服務生把髒盤子疊在托盤上。

ex.en: We took the streetcar downtown because it was cheap.
ex.zh: 我們因為便宜而搭有軌電車到市中心。

ex.en: The old streetcar rattled slowly down the main road.
ex.zh: 那輛老舊的有軌電車在大馬路上喀啦喀啦地慢慢行駛。

stereotyping.zh: 對…刻板印象化（stereotype 的現在分詞）

ex.en: Stop stereotyping people just because of where they come from.
ex.zh: 別只因為人家來自哪裡就對他們貼刻板標籤。

ex.en: The article warns against stereotyping older workers as bad with technology.
ex.zh: 這篇文章警告大家，不要把年長員工刻板地當成不懂科技。

stokes.zh: 添柴加火；煽動（stoke 的第三人稱單數）

ex.en: He stokes the fire every hour to keep the room warm.
ex.zh: 他每隔一小時就添柴生火，讓房間保持溫暖。

ex.en: The news stokes fears about rising prices.
ex.zh: 這則新聞煽動了人們對物價上漲的恐懼。

ex.en: We camped under a clear, starry sky.
ex.zh: 我們在晴朗、繁星滿天的夜空下露營。

ex.en: It was a starry night with no clouds at all.
ex.zh: 那是個毫無雲層、星光閃耀的夜晚。

ex.en: She studied computer science at Stanford.
ex.zh: 她在史丹佛大學讀電腦科學。

ex.en: Stanford is located in California.
ex.zh: 史丹佛大學位於加州。

ex.en: The statistician checked the survey results carefully.
ex.zh: 統計學家仔細檢查了問卷結果。

ex.en: My uncle works as a statistician for the government.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在政府擔任統計員。

ex.en: The sterilization of the tools takes ten minutes.
ex.zh: 這些器具的消毒需要十分鐘。

ex.en: Hospitals require strict sterilization of equipment.
ex.zh: 醫院要求對設備嚴格滅菌。

studied.zh: 學習、研究（study 的過去式）

ex.en: She studied English every night last year.
ex.zh: 她去年每天晚上都唸英文。

ex.en: He studied the map before leaving.
ex.zh: 他出發前仔細研究了地圖。

ex.en: She answered with a studied calm.
ex.zh: 她以刻意裝出的平靜回答。

ex.en: His studied politeness hid his anger.
ex.zh: 他刻意的禮貌掩飾了怒氣。

ex.en: Good structuring of your essay makes it easier to read.
ex.zh: 把文章結構安排好，會讓它更容易閱讀。

ex.en: The structuring of the new department took several months.
ex.zh: 新部門的架構規劃花了好幾個月。

ex.en: We walked home by starlight.
ex.zh: 我們藉著星光走路回家。

ex.en: The lake shimmered under the faint starlight.
ex.zh: 湖面在微弱的星光下閃爍。

ex.en: The two plans differ starkly in cost.
ex.zh: 這兩個計畫的成本截然不同。

ex.en: The empty room looked starkly white in the morning light.
ex.zh: 空蕩蕩的房間在晨光中顯得一片慘白。

stigmatize.zh: 污名化；貼上恥辱的標籤

ex.en: We should not stigmatize people who ask for help.
ex.zh: 我們不應該汙名化尋求協助的人。

ex.en: The media often stigmatizes certain neighborhoods.
ex.zh: 媒體常常把某些社區貼上負面標籤。

ex.en: A flock of starlings flew over the field.
ex.zh: 一群歐椋鳥飛過田野。

ex.en: The starling can copy the sounds of other birds.
ex.zh: 歐椋鳥能模仿其他鳥類的叫聲。

ex.en: The little girl fell asleep with a storybook in her hands.
ex.zh: 小女孩手裡拿著故事書睡著了。

ex.en: This storybook has beautiful pictures on every page.
ex.zh: 這本故事書每一頁都有漂亮的插圖。

ex.en: He stayed stoic even when he heard the bad news.
ex.zh: 就算聽到壞消息，他仍保持堅忍不動聲色。

ex.en: The stoic nurse never complained during the long shift.
ex.zh: 那位堅忍的護理師在漫長的班次中從不抱怨。

ex.en: My grandfather was a stoic who never showed his pain.
ex.zh: 我祖父是個堅忍克己的人，從不表露痛苦。

ex.en: As a stoic, she accepted the loss calmly.
ex.zh: 身為堅忍克己的人，她平靜地接受了損失。

ex.en: The ozone layer is found in the stratosphere.
ex.zh: 臭氧層位於平流層。

ex.en: Jet airplanes sometimes fly in the lower part of the stratosphere.
ex.zh: 噴射客機有時會飛在平流層的下層。

ex.en: The price of that house has gone into the stratosphere.
ex.zh: 那棟房子的價格已經高得離譜。

ex.en: After the hit song, the singer's fame soared into the stratosphere.
ex.zh: 那首暢銷歌曲之後，這位歌手的名氣一飛沖天。

ex.en: The standardisation of phone chargers would help everyone.
ex.zh: 手機充電器的標準化會讓大家都方便。

ex.en: Factories use standardisation to make parts that fit together.
ex.zh: 工廠運用標準化來製造能互相搭配的零件。

ex.en: The town is proud of its storied past.
ex.zh: 這座城鎮以它輝煌的歷史為傲。

ex.en: He played for a storied football club in Europe.
ex.zh: 他曾效力於歐洲一支歷史悠久的足球俱樂部。

ex.en: Our stateroom on the ship had a small window.
ex.zh: 我們在郵輪上的客艙有一扇小窗。

ex.en: He slept in his stateroom while the ship crossed the sea.
ex.zh: 船橫渡海洋時，他在自己的客艙裡睡覺。

ex.en: You can find the tea at any local stockist.
ex.zh: 你可以在任何當地經銷商那裡買到這種茶。

ex.en: The brand is looking for a new stockist in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 這個品牌正在台灣尋找新的經銷商。

ex.en: I felt stressed before the big exam.
ex.zh: 大考前我感到壓力很大。

ex.en: She is stressed because she has too many deadlines this week.
ex.zh: 她因為這週截止日太多而壓力很大。

ex.en: The new law stimulated economic growth.
ex.zh: 這項新法律刺激了經濟成長。

ex.en: The teacher's questions stimulated lively discussion in class.
ex.zh: 老師的提問激發了課堂上熱烈的討論。

ex.en: The students felt stimulated by the challenging project.
ex.zh: 學生們被這個有挑戰性的專案激發了熱情。

ex.en: A stimulated mind learns faster than a bored one.
ex.zh: 受到激發的頭腦比無聊的頭腦學得更快。

ex.en: The tree looked stunted because it grew in poor soil.
ex.zh: 這棵樹長在貧瘠的土壤裡，看起來發育不良。

ex.en: Lack of food left many children with stunted growth.
ex.zh: 缺乏食物使許多孩子成長受阻。

ex.en: I felt a strangeness in the house, as if someone had been there.
ex.zh: 我在屋裡感到一股異樣，彷彿有人來過。

ex.en: The strangeness of the new city made her feel lonely at first.
ex.zh: 新城市的陌生感讓她起初覺得孤單。

ex.en: My cousin is a streamer who plays video games online.
ex.zh: 我表哥是個在網路上玩電玩的實況主。

ex.en: The streamer chats with viewers during every game.
ex.zh: 那位實況主在每場遊戲中都和觀眾聊天。

ex.en: We hung colorful streamers across the party room.
ex.zh: 我們在派對房間裡掛上彩色的彩帶。

ex.en: The children waved paper streamers in the air.
ex.zh: 孩子們在空中揮舞紙彩帶。

ex.en: She called the police because a stalker kept following her home.
ex.zh: 她報了警，因為有個跟蹤狂一直跟著她回家。

ex.en: The actor hired extra security to protect himself from a stalker.
ex.zh: 那位演員多請了保全，以防範跟蹤狂。

ex.en: The stewardess offered us tea and snacks.
ex.zh: 空服員為我們送上茶和點心。

ex.en: My aunt worked as a stewardess for an airline in her youth.
ex.zh: 我阿姨年輕時在一家航空公司擔任空服員。

ex.en: The performer walked on stilts above the crowd.
ex.zh: 表演者踩著高蹺走在人群上方。

ex.en: The village houses stand on tall wooden stilts over the water.
ex.zh: 村裡的房子建在水面上高高的木樁上。

stripped.zh: 剝去；脫去（strip 的過去式）

ex.en: She stripped the old paint from the wooden chair.
ex.zh: 她把木椅上的舊油漆刮掉。

ex.en: The wind stripped the leaves from the trees overnight.
ex.zh: 一夜之間風把樹葉吹落殆盡。

ex.en: He stripped off his wet coat and hung it by the door.
ex.zh: 他脫下濕外套掛在門邊。

ex.en: The room had stripped floors and bare white walls.
ex.zh: 這個房間地板已去漆，牆面是光禿的白色。

ex.en: The stripped-down version of the app is faster.
ex.zh: 這個精簡版的應用程式速度更快。

ex.en: Caviar comes from the eggs of the sturgeon.
ex.zh: 魚子醬來自鱘魚的卵。

ex.en: A huge sturgeon was caught in the river.
ex.zh: 河裡捕到了一條巨大的鱘魚。

ex.en: The loud noise caused a stampede of cattle across the field.
ex.zh: 巨大的聲響讓牛群在田野上驚慌狂奔。

ex.en: There was a stampede for the exit when the alarm rang.
ex.zh: 警報響起時，人群蜂擁衝向出口。

ex.en: The thunder stampeded the horses out of the barn.
ex.zh: 雷聲嚇得馬匹衝出了馬廄。

ex.en: Shoppers stampeded into the store when the sale began.
ex.zh: 特賣一開始，顧客便蜂擁進入店裡。

stansted.zh: 斯坦斯特德（英國倫敦附近的機場）

ex.en: Stansted is an airport northeast of London.
ex.zh: 斯坦斯特德機場位於倫敦東北方。

ex.en: We flew into Stansted and took the train into the city.
ex.zh: 我們飛抵斯坦斯特德機場後搭火車進城。

ex.en: She has been a stalwart supporter of the school for years.
ex.zh: 多年來她一直是這所學校堅定的支持者。

ex.en: The stalwart guard stood at the gate all night.
ex.zh: 那位結實的衛兵整晚站在門口。

ex.en: He is a party stalwart who has volunteered for decades.
ex.zh: 他是黨內的中堅分子，已經當了幾十年的志工。

ex.en: The old stalwarts of the club still meet every Friday.
ex.zh: 俱樂部的老成員們至今仍每週五聚會。

ex.en: The structuralist studied how the parts of a language fit together.
ex.zh: 那位結構主義者研究語言的各個部分如何組合在一起。

ex.en: Structuralists believe that meaning comes from relationships within a system.
ex.zh: 結構主義者相信意義來自系統內部的關係。

ex.en: He pulled the stopper out of the bottle and poured the wine.
ex.zh: 他拔開瓶塞，把酒倒出來。

ex.en: Put the stopper back in so the perfume doesn't evaporate.
ex.zh: 把塞子塞回去，香水才不會揮發。

ex.en: She stoppered the bottle and put it back on the shelf.
ex.zh: 她把瓶子塞好，放回架子上。

ex.en: Make sure you stopper the flask tightly before shaking it.
ex.zh: 搖晃燒瓶之前，要確定塞緊瓶塞。

ex.en: The bride looked stunningly beautiful in her white dress.
ex.zh: 新娘穿著白紗，美得令人驚豔。

ex.en: The view from the top was stunningly clear.
ex.zh: 山頂的景色清晰得令人驚嘆。

ex.en: The staining on the carpet would not come out.
ex.zh: 地毯上的汙漬洗不掉。

ex.en: Wood staining gives the table a darker, richer color.
ex.zh: 木材染色讓桌子顏色變得更深更濃郁。

ex.en: Structuralism looks for patterns that shape language and culture.
ex.zh: 結構主義探尋塑造語言與文化的規律。

ex.en: We read an essay on structuralism in our theory class.
ex.zh: 我們在理論課上讀了一篇談結構主義的文章。

ex.en: She steadfastly refused to give up her dream.
ex.zh: 她堅定地拒絕放棄夢想。

ex.en: The nurses steadfastly cared for the patients all night.
ex.zh: 護理師整夜堅守崗位照顧病人。

ex.en: The church steeple could be seen from far away.
ex.zh: 從遠處就能看到教堂的尖塔。

ex.en: A bird built its nest on the steeple.
ex.zh: 一隻鳥在尖塔上築了巢。

ex.en: The bell in the steeple rings every hour.
ex.zh: 尖塔裡的鐘每小時響一次。

ex.en: Pour the pasta into a strainer to drain the water.
ex.zh: 把義大利麵倒進濾網裡瀝乾水。

ex.en: She used a tea strainer to catch the leaves.
ex.zh: 她用濾茶器擋住茶葉。

ex.en: The doctor listened to my chest with a stethoscope.
ex.zh: 醫生用聽診器聽我的胸部。

ex.en: The nurse wore a stethoscope around her neck.
ex.zh: 護理師脖子上掛著聽診器。

ex.en: He sat on the porch and strummed his guitar.
ex.zh: 他坐在門廊上隨意撥彈著吉他。

ex.en: She strums a few chords while she thinks of lyrics.
ex.zh: 她一邊想歌詞，一邊撥彈幾個和弦。

ex.en: The gentle strum of the guitar filled the room.
ex.zh: 輕柔的吉他撥弦聲充滿了房間。

ex.en: With one strum, the song began.
ex.zh: 隨著一下撥弦，歌曲開始了。

ex.en: The pianist played the passage in a light, staccato style.
ex.zh: 鋼琴家用輕快的斷奏方式演奏這一段。

ex.en: He answered in short, staccato sentences.
ex.zh: 他用簡短、斷斷續續的句子回答。

ex.en: The economy began to stagnate last year.
ex.zh: 經濟從去年開始陷入停滯。

ex.en: Don't let your career stagnate; keep learning.
ex.zh: 別讓你的事業停滯不前，要持續學習。

ex.en: His stubbornness made the discussion difficult.
ex.zh: 他的固執讓討論變得困難。

ex.en: Her stubbornness finally paid off when she won.
ex.zh: 她的堅持終於在獲勝時有了回報。

ex.en: He staggered down the hall after the long night shift.
ex.zh: 他熬完長長的大夜班後，搖搖晃晃地走過走廊。

ex.en: The runner staggered across the finish line and fell to the ground.
ex.zh: 那名跑者踉踉蹌蹌地越過終點線後倒在地上。

ex.en: We were staggered by how quickly the town had changed.
ex.zh: 這座小鎮變化之快讓我們大吃一驚。

ex.en: She was staggered to learn the bill was so high.
ex.zh: 她得知帳單金額這麼高時嚇了一大跳。

ex.en: The company uses staggered start times to reduce traffic.
ex.zh: 公司採用錯開的上班時間來減少交通壅塞。

ex.en: Students take lunch at staggered times so the cafeteria isn't crowded.
ex.zh: 學生們錯開時間用餐，餐廳才不會太擠。

ex.en: The meat was tough and stringy, so I couldn't finish it.
ex.zh: 那塊肉又老又多筋，我吃不完。

ex.en: Remove the stringy parts from the celery before cooking.
ex.zh: 煮之前先把芹菜多筋的部分去掉。

ex.en: She brushed her stringy hair away from her face.
ex.zh: 她把細細軟軟的頭髮從臉上撥開。

ex.en: The melted cheese became stringy as I pulled the pizza slice apart.
ex.zh: 我把披薩撕開時，融化的起司拉成了絲。

ex.en: He is a strapping young man who works on his family's farm.
ex.zh: 他是個在自家農場工作的魁梧年輕人。

ex.en: A strapping lad carried the heavy boxes up the stairs.
ex.zh: 一個壯碩的小伙子把沉重的箱子扛上樓。

ex.en: The nurse used medical strapping to support his sore ankle.
ex.zh: 護理師用固定膠帶支撐他疼痛的腳踝。

ex.en: Strapping around the boxes held them firmly together.
ex.zh: 綑在箱子外的帶子把它們牢牢固定在一起。

ex.en: The test results were startlingly good.
ex.zh: 測驗結果好得驚人。

ex.en: The two twins look startlingly alike.
ex.zh: 那對雙胞胎長得驚人地相像。

ex.en: He wore a starched white shirt to the interview.
ex.zh: 他穿著挺括的白襯衫去面試。

ex.en: The waiters had starched collars.
ex.zh: 服務生的衣領上了漿，很挺。

ex.en: The starched atmosphere of the office made me nervous.
ex.zh: 辦公室拘謹刻板的氣氛讓我很緊張。

ex.en: He was too starched to tell a joke.
ex.zh: 他太拘謹了，連個笑話都不敢說。

ex.en: He strenuously denied the accusation.
ex.zh: 他極力否認這項指控。

ex.en: They worked strenuously to finish before the deadline.
ex.zh: 他們拚命工作，想在期限前完成。

ex.en: My car stalled at the traffic light.
ex.zh: 我的車在紅綠燈前熄火了。

ex.en: Talks between the two sides stalled again.
ex.zh: 雙方的談判再度陷入停滯。

ex.en: The stalled project needs new funding.
ex.zh: 這個停擺的專案需要新的資金。

ex.en: We got stuck behind a stalled truck on the highway.
ex.zh: 我們在高速公路上被一輛拋錨的卡車擋在後面。

ex.en: Turn left at the next stoplight.
ex.zh: 在下一個紅綠燈左轉。

ex.en: The car stopped at the stoplight.
ex.zh: 車子在紅綠燈前停下來。

ex.en: The bank has a staid and serious image.
ex.zh: 這家銀行形象古板而嚴肅。

ex.en: He is a staid man who rarely takes risks.
ex.zh: 他是個穩重的人，很少冒險。

ex.en: The view from the mountain top was stupendous.
ex.zh: 從山頂望出去的景色令人驚嘆。

ex.en: They built the stadium at a stupendous cost.
ex.zh: 他們蓋這座體育場花費了驚人的成本。

ex.en: She put her foot in the stirrup and climbed onto the horse.
ex.zh: 她把腳踩進馬鐙，爬上了馬。

ex.en: The rider's boot slipped out of the stirrup.
ex.zh: 騎士的靴子從馬鐙中滑了出來。

ex.en: Herders on the steppe move with their sheep across wide grasslands.
ex.zh: 大草原上的牧人帶著羊群穿越遼闊的草地遷移。

ex.en: The train crossed the endless steppe for hours.
ex.zh: 火車在無邊無際的大草原上行駛了好幾個小時。

stalking.zh: 跟蹤；悄悄逼近（stalk 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The cat was stalking a bird in the garden.
ex.zh: 貓正在花園裡悄悄逼近一隻鳥。

ex.en: The police arrested a man for stalking his former classmate.
ex.zh: 警方逮捕了一名跟蹤前同學的男子。

ex.en: We are staying at a small hotel near the station.
ex.zh: 我們住在車站附近的一間小旅館。

ex.en: He is staying home today because he feels sick.
ex.zh: 他今天因為不舒服而待在家裡。

ex.en: She wore a red stiletto to the party.
ex.zh: 她穿著一雙紅色細跟高跟鞋去參加派對。

ex.en: It is hard to walk on cobblestones in stilettos.
ex.zh: 穿細跟高跟鞋走在鵝卵石路上很困難。

ex.en: The museum has an old stiletto from the sixteenth century.
ex.zh: 博物館收藏了一把十六世紀的細長短劍。

ex.en: The thin stiletto was hidden inside his coat.
ex.zh: 那把細長的短劍藏在他的外套裡。

ex.en: The economy remained in stasis for several years.
ex.zh: 經濟停滯了好幾年。

ex.en: A long period of stasis is bad for any company.
ex.zh: 長期停滯對任何公司都不好。

ex.en: I stupidly left my keys inside the car.
ex.zh: 我愚蠢地把鑰匙留在車裡了。

ex.en: He stood there stupidly, not knowing what to say.
ex.zh: 他呆呆地站在那裡，不知道該說什麼。

ex.en: He treats his stepson like his own child.
ex.zh: 他把繼子當成自己的孩子看待。

ex.en: Her stepson is studying in Japan.
ex.zh: 她的繼子正在日本讀書。

ex.en: Grain was kept in the storehouse behind the farm.
ex.zh: 穀物存放在農場後面的倉庫裡。

ex.en: The library is a storehouse of knowledge.
ex.zh: 圖書館是知識的寶庫。

ex.en: Call me straightaway if anything goes wrong.
ex.zh: 如果出了任何問題，馬上打給我。

ex.en: She understood the problem straightaway.
ex.zh: 她立刻就理解了這個問題。

ex.en: The car sped up on the long straightaway.
ex.zh: 車子在長長的直道上加速。

ex.en: Runners picked up speed on the final straightaway.
ex.zh: 跑者在最後的直道上加快速度。

ex.en: The bus stopped in front of the school.
ex.zh: 公車停在學校前面。

ex.en: It finally stopped raining this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午雨終於停了。

ex.en: I felt a stabbing pain in my side when I ran.
ex.zh: 我跑步時側腹一陣刺痛。

ex.en: A stabbing headache kept her up all night.
ex.zh: 一陣劇烈的頭痛讓她整夜沒睡。

ex.en: The young starlet attended her first film festival.
ex.zh: 年輕的新星參加了她的第一個影展。

ex.en: Magazines called her the brightest starlet of the year.
ex.zh: 雜誌稱她為年度最耀眼的新星。

ex.en: She staunchly defended her friend.
ex.zh: 她堅定地為朋友辯護。

ex.en: The villagers staunchly refused to leave their homes.
ex.zh: 村民堅決拒絕離開家園。

ex.en: We eat from blue stoneware plates.
ex.zh: 我們用藍色炻器盤子吃飯。

ex.en: The potter made a set of stoneware mugs.
ex.zh: 陶藝家做了一組炻器馬克杯。

ex.en: The old steamboat carried passengers down the river.
ex.zh: 那艘老汽船載著乘客沿河而下。

ex.en: Mark Twain wrote about life on the steamboat.
ex.zh: 馬克·吐溫曾寫過汽船上的生活。

ex.en: He studiously avoided talking about money during dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐時他刻意避開談錢的話題。

ex.en: She studiously copied every word from the board.
ex.zh: 她認真地把黑板上每個字都抄下來。

ex.en: The bike has a small stabilizer to keep the child from falling.
ex.zh: 這輛腳踏車有個小輔助輪，免得孩子跌倒。

ex.en: A stabilizer on the camera keeps the video from shaking.
ex.zh: 相機上的穩定器能避免影片晃動。

ex.en: He sat in a drunken stupor on the sofa.
ex.zh: 他醉得昏昏沉沉地坐在沙發上。

ex.en: The news shook her out of her stupor.
ex.zh: 這則消息把她從恍惚中驚醒。

ex.en: The stitching on this bag is very neat.
ex.zh: 這個包包的縫線非常整齊。

ex.en: The coat came apart because the stitching was weak.
ex.zh: 因為縫線不牢，那件外套裂開了。

ex.en: Stratospheric winds can reach very high speeds.
ex.zh: 同溫層的風速可以非常快。

ex.en: The balloon rose to a stratospheric height.
ex.zh: 氣球升到了同溫層的高度。

ex.en: One company has a stranglehold on the local market.
ex.zh: 有一家公司牢牢壟斷了當地市場。

ex.en: High rent has a stranglehold on small businesses in the city.
ex.zh: 高額租金扼住了這個城市小商家的生計。

ex.en: The film, starring a famous young actress, opens next week.
ex.zh: 這部由一位知名年輕女演員主演的電影下週上映。

ex.en: We watched a comedy starring two of our favorite actors.
ex.zh: 我們看了一部由兩位我們最喜歡的演員主演的喜劇。

ex.en: The cliff showed stratified layers of rock.
ex.zh: 懸崖露出了一層一層的岩層。

ex.en: It was a stratified society with a clear gap between rich and poor.
ex.zh: 那是個階層分明、貧富差距明顯的社會。

ex.en: The stagecoach carried mail and passengers across the plains.
ex.zh: 驛馬車載著郵件和乘客穿越平原。

ex.en: In old Western films, a stagecoach is often chased by bandits.
ex.zh: 在老西部電影裡，驛馬車常被強盜追趕。

stretched.zh: 伸展；拉長（stretch 的過去式）

ex.en: She stretched her arms above her head and yawned.
ex.zh: 她把雙臂伸過頭頂，打了個呵欠。

ex.en: The rope stretched tight between the two trees.
ex.zh: 繩子在兩棵樹之間拉得緊緊的。

ex.en: Our budget is stretched this month because of the repairs.
ex.zh: 因為維修費用，我們這個月的預算很吃緊。

ex.en: The hospital's stretched staff are working long hours.
ex.zh: 醫院人手吃緊的員工正在長時間工作。

ex.en: In old films, a patient is sometimes shown in a straitjacket.
ex.zh: 在老電影裡，病人有時會被畫面呈現穿著拘束衣。

ex.en: Strict rules put the company in a straitjacket and stopped new ideas.
ex.zh: 嚴格的規定把公司綁手綁腳，扼殺了新點子。

ex.en: You should sterilise the baby bottles before use.
ex.zh: 奶瓶使用前應該先消毒。

ex.en: The nurse used heat to sterilise the tools.
ex.zh: 護理師用高溫將器具消毒。

ex.en: The vet will sterilise the cat next week.
ex.zh: 獸醫下週會替這隻貓結紮。

ex.en: Many owners choose to sterilise their pets.
ex.zh: 許多飼主選擇替寵物結紮。

ex.en: The strongman at the circus lifted a car.
ex.zh: 馬戲團的大力士舉起了一輛車。

ex.en: He watched a strongman pull a truck across the field.
ex.zh: 他看一位大力士拉著卡車穿過場地。

ex.en: He taught his stepdaughter how to ride a bike.
ex.zh: 他教繼女騎腳踏車。

ex.en: Her stepdaughter calls her every Sunday.
ex.zh: 她的繼女每個週日都會打電話給她。

staged.zh: 上演；舉辦（stage 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The students staged a play at the end of the year.
ex.zh: 學生們在年底上演了一齣戲。

ex.en: The town staged a big parade for the festival.
ex.zh: 小鎮為慶典舉辦了盛大的遊行。

ex.en: The photo looked staged to me.
ex.zh: 那張照片在我看來是擺拍的。

ex.en: Her surprise seemed staged, not real.
ex.zh: 她的驚訝看起來是裝出來的，不是真的。

ex.en: A few tired runners straggled across the finish line.
ex.zh: 幾個疲憊的跑者零零落落地跑過終點線。

ex.en: Houses straggle along the road for several miles.
ex.zh: 房屋沿著道路零星散布了好幾英里。

ex.en: We used a stencil to paint the letters on the sign.
ex.zh: 我們用模板把字母漆在招牌上。

ex.en: The teacher cut a star-shaped stencil out of cardboard.
ex.zh: 老師用紙板剪出一個星形的模板。

ex.en: He stencilled his name on the wooden box.
ex.zh: 他用模板把名字印在木箱上。

ex.en: The children stencilled flowers on the classroom wall.
ex.zh: 孩子們用模板在教室牆上印出花朵。

ex.en: A white stork stood on one leg beside the pond.
ex.zh: 一隻白鸛單腳站在池塘邊。

ex.en: The storks build huge nests on the tops of old chimneys.
ex.zh: 鸛會在老煙囪頂端築起巨大的巢。

ex.en: The strobe lights flashed over the dance floor.
ex.zh: 頻閃燈在舞池上方閃爍。

ex.en: A strobe on the bicycle makes you easier to see at night.
ex.zh: 腳踏車上的閃光燈讓你在夜裡更容易被看見。

ex.en: A few stragglers reached the finish line an hour later.
ex.zh: 幾個落後的人一小時後才抵達終點。

ex.en: The guide waited for the last straggler before leaving.
ex.zh: 導遊等最後一位掉隊的人到了才出發。

ex.en: Scientists say we are all made of stardust.
ex.zh: 科學家說我們都是由星塵組成的。

ex.en: The poem compares tiny dreams to specks of stardust.
ex.zh: 這首詩把小小的夢想比作一粒粒星塵。

statin.zh: 他汀類藥物（降膽固醇藥）

ex.en: The doctor gave him a statin to lower his cholesterol.
ex.zh: 醫師開了他汀類藥物給他降膽固醇。

ex.en: Some people take a statin every day to protect their hearts.
ex.zh: 有些人每天服用他汀類藥物來保護心臟。

ex.en: Someone left a stinking bag of trash in the hall.
ex.zh: 有人在走廊留下一袋發臭的垃圾。

ex.en: The stinking fish market was hard to walk through.
ex.zh: 那個惡臭的魚市場讓人很難走過去。

ex.en: The cat made a stealthy approach toward the bird.
ex.zh: 貓悄悄地靠近那隻鳥。

ex.en: He took a stealthy glance at her phone.
ex.zh: 他偷偷瞄了一眼她的手機。

ex.en: We found a starfish on the beach after the tide went out.
ex.zh: 退潮後我們在海灘上發現了一隻海星。

ex.en: A starfish has five arms and no brain.
ex.zh: 海星有五隻腕，沒有腦。

ex.en: She put a small statuette on the bookshelf.
ex.zh: 她把一尊小雕像放在書架上。

ex.en: The winner received a gold statuette.
ex.zh: 得獎者獲頒一座金色小雕像。

ex.en: The stamping of passports at the border took a long time.
ex.zh: 在邊境替護照蓋章花了很長的時間。

ex.en: Metal stamping is used to make car parts.
ex.zh: 金屬沖壓被用來製造汽車零件。

stamping.zh: 跺腳；蓋章（stamp 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The child was stamping her feet because she wanted candy.
ex.zh: 那個孩子因為想吃糖而用力跺腳。

ex.en: He is stamping each letter before sending it.
ex.zh: 他寄出每封信之前都會先蓋章。

ex.en: The stylus touched the record and the music began.
ex.zh: 唱針碰到唱片，音樂就響起了。

ex.en: She used a stylus to draw on the tablet.
ex.zh: 她用觸控筆在平板上畫圖。

ex.en: The coach timed the race with a stopwatch.
ex.zh: 教練用碼錶為賽跑計時。

ex.en: I pressed the button on the stopwatch to start.
ex.zh: 我按下碼錶的按鈕開始計時。

ex.en: My parents always stood by me when I was in trouble.
ex.zh: 我遇到麻煩時，父母總是支持我。

ex.en: A good friend will stand by you no matter what.
ex.zh: 好朋友無論如何都會挺你。

stand by.en: to continue to support someone, especially in a difficult time

ex.en: The doctors are standing by in case of an emergency.
ex.zh: 醫生們隨時待命，以防緊急狀況。

ex.en: Please stand by while we fix the problem.
ex.zh: 我們修復問題的這段時間，請稍候待命。

stand by.en: to be ready to help or act if needed

ex.en: I stand by what I said yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天說的話，我會負責到底。

ex.en: The company stood by its promise to refund every customer.
ex.zh: 公司信守承諾，退款給每位顧客。

stand by.en: to keep a promise or decision

ex.en: How can you just stand by and watch him struggle?
ex.zh: 你怎麼能就這樣袖手旁觀，看著他吃苦？

ex.en: Nobody should stand by when someone is being bullied.
ex.zh: 有人被霸凌時，誰都不該袖手旁觀。

stand by.en: to do nothing while something bad happens

ex.en: What does "NBA" stand for?
ex.zh: 「NBA」是什麼的縮寫？

ex.en: The red color on the flag stands for courage.
ex.zh: 旗子上的紅色象徵勇氣。

stand for.en: to be the short form of something or to mean something

ex.en: Our school stands for honesty and hard work.
ex.zh: 我們學校崇尚誠實與努力。

ex.en: I want to vote for someone who stands for fairness.
ex.zh: 我想投給主張公平的人。

stand for.en: to support an idea or believe in a set of values

ex.en: I won't stand for rude behavior in my classroom.
ex.zh: 我不會容忍在我的教室裡有無禮的行為。

ex.en: She wouldn't stand for being treated like that.
ex.zh: 她不肯忍受那樣的對待。

stand for.en: to accept bad behavior, usually used in negative sentences

ex.en: Her bright yellow coat made her stand out in the crowd.
ex.zh: 她亮黃色的外套讓她在人群中很顯眼。

ex.en: To get the job, you need to stand out from other applicants.
ex.zh: 想得到這份工作，你得從其他應徵者中脫穎而出。

stand out.en: to be easy to notice because of being different or better

ex.en: Everyone stood up when the teacher walked in.
ex.zh: 老師走進來時，大家都站了起來。

ex.en: He stood up to give his seat to an old woman.
ex.zh: 他站起來，把座位讓給一位老太太。

stand up.en: to rise from a sitting position and be on your feet

ex.en: I waited an hour, but she stood me up.
ex.zh: 我等了一個小時，她卻放我鴿子。

ex.en: He was upset because his friend stood him up again.
ex.zh: 他很不開心，因為朋友又放了他鴿子。

stand up.en: to not come to a date or meeting without telling the other person

ex.en: You should stand up for yourself when people are unfair.
ex.zh: 別人不公平時，你應該為自己挺身而出。

ex.en: She finally stood up to her boss and said no.
ex.zh: 她終於勇敢對老闆說不。

stand up.en: to defend yourself or others against something unfair

ex.en: His story will not stand up in court.
ex.zh: 他的說法在法庭上站不住腳。

ex.en: These boots stand up well to rain and mud.
ex.zh: 這雙靴子很耐得住雨水和泥巴。

stand up.en: to be strong or true enough to pass a test or check

ex.en: Always stand up for what you believe is right.
ex.zh: 要永遠為你相信的正確事物挺身而出。

ex.en: He stood up for his little brother at school.
ex.zh: 他在學校為弟弟挺身而出。

stand up for.en: to defend or support someone or something

ex.en: Stay away from the edge of the cliff.
ex.zh: 離懸崖邊遠一點。

ex.en: The doctor told him to stay away from fried food.
ex.zh: 醫生叫他遠離油炸食物。

stay away.en: to not go near someone or something

ex.en: Many fans stayed away because of the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 因為下大雨，許多球迷沒有到場。

ex.en: She stayed away from work for three days.
ex.zh: 她有三天沒去上班。

stay away.en: to not go to a place or event

ex.en: It's cold tonight, so let's stay in and watch a movie.
ex.zh: 今晚很冷，我們待在家看電影吧。

ex.en: I stayed in all weekend to finish my report.
ex.zh: 我整個週末都待在家寫報告。

stay in.en: to remain at home instead of going out

ex.en: My parents don't let me stay out after eleven.
ex.zh: 我爸媽不准我十一點以後還在外面。

ex.en: The kids stayed out playing until it got dark.
ex.zh: 孩子們在外面玩到天黑。

stay out.en: to remain outside the home, especially late at night

ex.en: Please stay out of my business.
ex.zh: 請不要管我的事。

ex.en: I decided to stay out of their argument.
ex.zh: 我決定不介入他們的爭吵。

stay out.en: to not become involved in something

ex.en: We stayed up late talking about our trip.
ex.zh: 我們熬夜聊旅行的事。

ex.en: Don't stay up too late, or you'll be tired tomorrow.
ex.zh: 別熬太晚，不然明天會很累。

stay up.en: to not go to bed until late

ex.en: The manager will step down at the end of this year.
ex.zh: 經理將在今年年底卸任。

ex.en: After ten years, the coach decided to step down.
ex.zh: 十年後，教練決定下台。

step down.en: to leave an important job or position

ex.en: She stepped down from the stage and waved to us.
ex.zh: 她走下舞台，對我們揮手。

ex.en: Please step down carefully from the bus.
ex.zh: 下公車時請小心。

step down.en: to move down from a higher place by walking

ex.en: The teacher stepped in to stop the fight.
ex.zh: 老師出面制止了這場爭執。

ex.en: When the project fell behind, our boss stepped in.
ex.zh: 專案落後時，我們老闆出面處理。

step in.en: to become involved in a situation to help or stop something

ex.en: He stepped in and closed the door behind him.
ex.zh: 他走進來，並把門關上。

ex.en: Come on, step in out of the rain.
ex.zh: 來吧，進來躲雨。

ex.en: A nail was sticking out of the old wooden board.
ex.zh: 舊木板上有一根釘子突了出來。

ex.en: Her red hair makes her stick out in any crowd.
ex.zh: 她的紅頭髮讓她在人群中特別醒目。

stick out.en: to extend beyond a surface, or to be easy to notice

ex.en: We should stick to the plan we made yesterday.
ex.zh: 我們應該照著昨天訂的計畫走。

ex.en: He stuck to his diet even at the party.
ex.zh: 他即使在派對上也堅持飲食計畫。

stick to.en: to keep following a plan, rule, or decision

ex.en: The sticker will not stick to a wet wall.
ex.zh: 貼紙貼不住濕的牆壁。

ex.en: Mud stuck to my shoes all the way home.
ex.zh: 一路回家，泥巴都黏在我的鞋子上。

stick to.en: to be attached to a surface with something sticky

ex.en: I'll stick with my old phone for another year.
ex.zh: 我的舊手機會再用一年。

ex.en: If you stick with it, you will get better.
ex.zh: 只要你堅持下去，就會越來越進步。

stick with.en: to continue doing or using something

ex.en: Stick with me, and you won't get lost.
ex.zh: 跟緊我，你就不會迷路。

ex.en: The kids stuck with their teacher during the museum trip.
ex.zh: 孩子們在參觀博物館時緊跟著老師。

ex.en: His kind words stuck with me for years.
ex.zh: 他親切的話語我記了好多年。

ex.en: That song has stuck with me since I was a child.
ex.zh: 那首歌從我小時候就一直留在我心裡。

ex.en: I'll stop by the store on my way home.
ex.zh: 我回家路上會順道去一下那家店。

ex.en: Feel free to stop by anytime this week.
ex.zh: 這個星期隨時歡迎順道過來坐坐。

stop by.en: to visit a place briefly on the way somewhere

ex.en: Follow the instructions step by step.
ex.zh: 請逐步照著說明做。

ex.en: She learned to swim step by step.
ex.zh: 她一步一步學會了游泳。

step by step.en: slowly, one stage at a time

ex.en: Our team doesn't stand a chance against the champions.
ex.zh: 我們的隊伍對上冠軍隊毫無勝算。

ex.en: If you practice every day, you stand a chance of winning.
ex.zh: 如果你每天練習，就有機會贏。

stand a chance.en: to have a possibility of success
